Requirement (EN): Document metadata: Garis Panduan Micro-Credential UTeM, Version 1.0, Date 18 September 2026, prepared by CODL UTeM.
Original wording (BM, short): GARIS PANDUAN MICRO-CREDENTIAL UTeM, Versi 1.0, 18 September 2026, Disediakan oleh CODL, UTeM.

Requirement (EN): Every Micro-Credential must have clear learning outcomes supported by appropriate learning activities and assessment.
Original wording (BM, short): Setiap MC hendaklah mempunyai hasil pembelajaran yang jelas serta disokong oleh aktiviti pembelajaran dan pentaksiran yang bersesuaian.

Requirement (EN): MC development and implementation must take into account MQF, MQA guidelines, and prevailing institutional policies.
Original wording (BM, short): Pembangunan dan pelaksanaannya hendaklah mengambil kira Malaysian Qualifications Framework (MQF), garis panduan MQA serta dasar dan ketetapan berkaitan.

Requirement (EN): System must communicate and never misrepresent that completion of an MC by itself confers academic credit value or credit transfer eligibility.
Original wording (BM, short): Penyempurnaan sesuatu MC tidak dengan sendirinya memberikan nilai kredit akademik atau kelayakan untuk pemindahan kredit.

Requirement (EN): UTeM MCs must be categorized into exactly three categories: Unbundled Micro-Credential (UMC), Stand-alone Micro-Credential (SAMC), and Micro-Credential Eksekutif (MCE).
Original wording (BM, short): Micro-Credential UTeM dikategorikan kepada Unbundled Micro-Credential (UMC), Stand-alone Micro-Credential (SAMC) dan Micro-Credential Eksekutif (MCE).

Requirement (EN): The Guide must serve as the official institutional reference for faculties, PTjs, instructors, coordinators, committees, and stakeholders.
Original wording (BM, short): Garis panduan ini hendaklah menjadi rujukan kepada fakulti, Pusat Tanggungjawab (PTj), tenaga pengajar, penyelaras, jawatankuasa dan pihak berkepentingan.

Requirement (EN): Purpose and objectives of the Guide: uniform framework for MC lifecycle aligned with UTeM policies, MQF, and MQA guidelines.
Original wording (BM, short): Garis panduan ini bertujuan menyediakan kerangka yang seragam bagi pembangunan, kelulusan, penawaran, pelaksanaan, jaminan kualiti, pengiktirafan, pemantauan dan penambahbaikan MC.

Requirement (EN): Guide applies to all faculties, PTjs, and external collaborations (industry, professional bodies, government agencies, institutions); responsible PTj must ensure partner compliance.
Original wording (BM, short): Garis panduan ini hendaklah diguna pakai oleh semua fakulti, PTj... PTj yang bertanggungjawab hendaklah memastikan kerjasama tersebut mematuhi garis panduan ini.

Requirement (EN): Development, QA, and recognition requirements/workflows must be determined based on the MC category (UMC, SAMC, or MCE).
Original wording (BM, short): Keperluan pembangunan, jaminan kualiti dan pengiktirafan hendaklah ditentukan berdasarkan kategori MC yang berkenaan.

Requirement (EN): Lifecycle scope spans needs analysis, category determination, LO/SLT/content/assessment design, content development, review/approval, offering/delivery, assessment, certification, records, monitoring, and CQI.
Original wording (BM, short): Skop pembangunan dan pelaksanaan merangkumi analisis keperluan, penentuan kategori MC, reka bentuk hasil pembelajaran, SLT, kandungan dan pentaksiran...

Requirement (EN): System must communicate and ensure that fulfilling SLT or completing an MC does not automatically confer credit value, credit transfer, programme admission, or award of an academic qualification.
Original wording (BM, short): Pemenuhan SLT atau penyempurnaan sesuatu MC tidak secara automatik memberikan nilai kredit, pemindahan kredit, kemasukan ke program atau penganugerahan kelayakan akademik.

Requirement (EN): Quality assurance must be implemented according to MC category (academic review, constructive alignment, internal approval, QV, monitoring, CQI).
Original wording (BM, short): Jaminan kualiti hendaklah dilaksanakan berdasarkan kategori MC dan boleh merangkumi semakan akademik, keselarasan hasil pembelajaran, SLT dan pentaksiran, kelulusan dalaman, QV...

Requirement (EN): Delivery mode must support Face-to-Face (Bersemuka), Online (Dalam Talian), Blended (Teradun), or other suitable method aligned with LO, activities, assessment, and learner profile.
Original wording (BM, short): MC boleh dilaksanakan secara bersemuka, dalam talian, teradun (blended learning) atau kaedah lain yang bersesuaian. Kaedah penyampaian hendaklah sejajar...

Requirement (EN): Target groups may include students, graduates, professionals, industry workers, government agencies, organizations, community, and general public.
Original wording (BM, short): MC UTeM boleh ditawarkan kepada pelajar, graduan, profesional, pekerja industri, agensi kerajaan, organisasi, komuniti dan masyarakat umum.

Requirement (EN): For MCs developed/delivered with external partners using UTeM's name or recognition, academic standard, QA, and regulatory compliance must remain under UTeM oversight.
Original wording (BM, short): Bagi MC yang menggunakan nama atau pengiktirafan UTeM, tanggungjawab terhadap standard akademik, jaminan kualiti dan pematuhan... hendaklah kekal di bawah kawal selia UTeM.

Requirement (EN): Guide must be read together with UTeM policies and any specific MQA, regulatory, or professional body requirements.
Original wording (BM, short): Garis panduan ini hendaklah dibaca bersama dasar dan peraturan UTeM yang berkaitan. Sekiranya terdapat ketetapan khusus oleh MQA, badan kawal selia atau badan profesional...

Requirement (EN): Glossary of 20 authoritative terms (ABC, ACR, CQI, Credential, Credit Accumulation, Credit Transfer, Credit-Bearing Credential, Currency of Knowledge, Digital Badge, Digital Credential, Formal Learning, LO, Stackable Degree, MC, MCE, Non-Formal Learning, Material Change, QA, QV, QV-SAMC, Rekod Pencapaian Pembelajaran MC UTeM, SAMC, SLT, UMC).
Original wording (BM, short): Jadual 4. Definisi dan Glosari istilah utama ekosistem Micro-Credential UTeM.

Requirement (EN): Internal UTeM MC Learning Achievement Record (Rekod Pencapaian Pembelajaran Micro-Credential UTeM) must be strictly separated from Academic Credit Record (ACR).
Original wording (BM, short): Rekod dalaman UTeM yang mendokumentasikan pencapaian peserta... Rekod ini hendaklah dibezakan daripada ACR.

Requirement (EN): For ABC deposit from non-formal learning, ONLY Stand-alone Micro-Credential (SAMC) that has passed Quality Verification and met relevant requirements may be deposited.
Original wording (BM, short): Dalam konteks deposit ABC bagi Micro-Credential, hanya Stand-alone Micro-Credential (SAMC) yang telah melalui Quality Verification dan memenuhi keperluan berkaitan boleh didepositkan.

Requirement (EN): Standard abbreviations list (ABC, ACR, CQI, MC, MCE, MQA, MQF, PTj, QA, QV, SAMC, SLT, UMC).
Original wording (BM, short): Senarai 13 singkatan rasmi: ABC, ACR, CQI, MC, MCE, MQA, MQF, PTj, QA, QV, SAMC, SLT, UMC.

Requirement (EN): MC recognition/award must be granted strictly based on verified learning achievement (assessment), NOT solely on participation or attendance.
Original wording (BM, short): Pengiktirafan hendaklah diberikan berdasarkan pencapaian pembelajaran dan bukan semata-mata berdasarkan penyertaan atau kehadiran.

Requirement (EN): A UMC module must NOT be treated or classified as a SAMC solely because the module can be completed independently.
Original wording (BM, short): Sesuatu modul UMC juga tidak boleh dianggap sebagai SAMC hanya kerana modul tersebut boleh diselesaikan secara berasingan.

Requirement (EN): MC category (UMC, SAMC, or MCE) must be identified at the initial development/proposal stage.
Original wording (BM, short): Kategori hendaklah dikenal pasti pada peringkat awal pembangunan kerana pengelasan tersebut menentukan reka bentuk, proses kelulusan, jaminan kualiti dan bentuk pengiktirafan.

Requirement (EN): UMC must be unbundled from a credit-bearing course in an accredited UTeM programme and record explicit academic linkage to parent course and programme (LO mapping, SLT, content, assessment).
Original wording (BM, short): UMC hendaklah mengekalkan hubungan akademik yang jelas dengan kursus dan program induk, termasuk pemetaan hasil pembelajaran, SLT, kandungan dan pentaksiran.

Requirement (EN): Completing an individual UMC module (or earning its Digital Badge) must NOT by itself mark the entire UMC complete or confer academic credit for the parent course.
Original wording (BM, short): penyempurnaan modul secara individu tidak dengan sendirinya menunjukkan penyempurnaan keseluruhan UMC atau memberikan kredit akademik bagi kursus induk.

Requirement (EN): Total SLT across all modules of a UMC must align with (equal) the SLT of the parent credit-bearing course.
Original wording (BM, short): Jumlah keseluruhan SLT bagi sesuatu UMC hendaklah selaras dengan SLT kursus induk.

Requirement (EN): Entire UMC structure representing a credit-bearing course must have at least 40 hours SLT (equivalent to at least 1 academic credit).
Original wording (BM, short): keseluruhan struktur UMC hendaklah mempunyai sekurang-kurangnya 40 jam SLT atau bersamaan sekurang-kurangnya satu (1) kredit akademik.

Requirement (EN): System must support recording the 3 UMC unbundling models: (a) Credit-Based (Berasaskan Kredit), (b) Topic-Based (Berasaskan Topik), and (c) Separate Learning and Assessment (Pembelajaran dan Pentaksiran Berasingan).
Original wording (BM, short): (a) Model Penyahhimpunan Berasaskan Kredit; (b) Model Penyahhimpunan Berasaskan Topik; (c) Model Penyahhimpunan Pembelajaran dan Pentaksiran Berasingan.

Requirement (EN): Under Credit-Based UMC Unbundling Model, each module must have at least 40 hours SLT covering learning, activities, and assessment.
Original wording (BM, short): Model Penyahhimpunan Berasaskan Kredit, iaitu setiap modul mempunyai sekurang-kurangnya 40 jam SLT dan merangkumi pembelajaran, aktiviti dan pentaksiran.

Requirement (EN): Combining one UMC module with a module from a different parent course is prohibited unless formal equivalence mapping approval (PLO, CLO, MQF etc.) is obtained.
Original wording (BM, short): Gabungan satu modul dengan modul lain yang berlainan induk adalah tidak dibenarkan, melainkan telah mendapat kelulusan kesetaraan pemetaan PLO, CLO, MQF.

Requirement (EN): SAMC must be developed as a standalone offering (not an official component of any accredited UTeM programme) with its own identity, LO, SLT, content, learning activities, and assessment.
Original wording (BM, short): SAMC ialah MC yang dibangunkan sebagai penawaran pembelajaran tersendiri dan bukan komponen rasmi mana-mana program akademik berakreditasi UTeM. SAMC hendaklah mempunyai identiti, hasil pembelajaran, SLT...

Requirement (EN): SAMC must have at least 40 hours SLT.
Original wording (BM, short): Bagi tujuan klasifikasi UTeM, SAMC mempunyai sekurang-kurangnya 40 jam SLT.

Requirement (EN): Fulfilling 40 hours SLT for SAMC must NOT automatically assign academic credit value or MQF level; SAMC seeking credit/MQF must pass Quality Verification (QV) first and reflect only the QV decision.
Original wording (BM, short): pemenuhan 40 jam SLT tidak secara automatik memberikan nilai kredit atau tahap MQF. SAMC yang dicadangkan untuk memperoleh nilai kredit akademik dan tahap MQF hendaklah melalui proses Quality Verification (QV).

Requirement (EN): MCE must have strictly less than 40 hours SLT (< 40 hours) while still having learning outcomes, content, learning activities, assessment, and internal UTeM QA.
Original wording (BM, short): MCE mempunyai kurang daripada 40 jam SLT. Walaupun bukan penawaran kredit, MCE hendaklah mempunyai hasil pembelajaran, kandungan, aktiviti pembelajaran dan pentaksiran.

Requirement (EN): MCE must be excluded from SAMC QV, carry no academic credit value, and be blocked from direct credit transfer, ACR/ABC deposit, or Stackable Degree pathways.
Original wording (BM, short): MCE tidak tertakluk kepada QV bagi SAMC, tidak membawa nilai kredit akademik dan tidak boleh digunakan secara langsung untuk pemindahan kredit atau laluan Stackable Degree.

Requirement (EN): If an MCE offering is to be considered for credit recognition, it must be reclassified and re-approved as a SAMC before undergoing QV.
Original wording (BM, short): Sekiranya sesuatu penawaran MCE hendak dipertimbangkan untuk pengiktirafan kredit, penawaran tersebut hendaklah diklasifikasikan dan diluluskan semula sebagai SAMC sebelum melalui mekanisme QV.

Requirement (EN): MC category (UMC, SAMC, MCE) must be verified and confirmed through UTeM's review and approval process before the offering is executed.
Original wording (BM, short): Kategori Micro-Credential hendaklah disahkan melalui proses semakan dan kelulusan UTeM sebelum penawaran dilaksanakan.

Requirement (EN): Recognition information displayed to users must clearly reflect the MC category and must NOT imply that all MCs carry academic credit or can be used automatically in an academic programme.
Original wording (BM, short): Pengiktirafan yang diberikan hendaklah sentiasa dinyatakan dengan jelas berdasarkan kategori Micro-Credential dan tidak boleh memberi gambaran bahawa semua Micro-Credential membawa kredit akademik.

Requirement (EN): Institutional principles: regulatory/policy compliance by category, LO-oriented design, competency-based evidence (not attendance alone).
Original wording (BM, short): Pembangunan dan pelaksanaan MC hendaklah mematuhi dasar... berorientasikan hasil pembelajaran... berasaskan kompetensi.

Requirement (EN): For modular UMC, learners must be able to complete modules across different time periods/cohorts subject to approved UMC structure, learning validity, and academic regulations.
Original wording (BM, short): Bagi UMC modular, peserta boleh menyempurnakan modul pada tempoh yang berbeza tertakluk kepada struktur UMC, tempoh kesahan pembelajaran dan ketetapan akademik.

Requirement (EN): Industry/professional/SME involvement encouraged where relevant; QA applies across the whole MC ecosystem while QV is specific to SAMC.
Original wording (BM, short): Penglibatan industri, badan profesional, pakar bidang... digalakkan. QA terpakai kepada keseluruhan ekosistem MC, manakala QV merupakan mekanisme khusus bagi SAMC.

Requirement (EN): Any material change affecting LO, SLT, assessment, credit value, MQF level, or QV status must undergo relevant review and re-approval before implementation.
Original wording (BM, short): Sekiranya penambahbaikan melibatkan perubahan signifikan (material change) yang menjejaskan hasil pembelajaran, SLT, pentaksiran, nilai kredit, tahap MQF atau status QV, perubahan tersebut hendaklah melalui proses semakan dan kelulusan.

Requirement (EN): Every MC record/design must contain all 6 integrated components: (a) Learning Outcomes, (b) SLT, (c) Learning Content, (d) Learning Activities, (e) Assessment, and (f) Certification & Recognition.
Original wording (BM, short): Setiap Micro-Credential hendaklah mengandungi enam (6) komponen utama yang saling berkaitan: Hasil Pembelajaran, SLT, Kandungan Pembelajaran, Aktiviti Pembelajaran, Pentaksiran, Pensijilan dan Pengiktirafan.

Requirement (EN): For UMC, learning outcomes must be explicitly mapped to parent course learning outcomes (CLOs).
Original wording (BM, short): Bagi UMC, hasil pembelajaran hendaklah dipetakan kepada hasil pembelajaran kursus induk.

Requirement (EN): SLT calculation must include all learning activities and assessments, not only instructor contact hours.
Original wording (BM, short): SLT hendaklah merangkumi semua aktiviti pembelajaran dan pentaksiran yang berkaitan dan bukan hanya masa interaksi bersama tenaga pengajar.

Requirement (EN): Content must be sufficient, relevant, current, and retain linkage to parent course for UMC; activities must align with LO, content, delivery mode, and SLT.
Original wording (BM, short): Kandungan pembelajaran hendaklah mencukupi, relevan dan terkini... Bagi UMC, kandungan modul hendaklah mengekalkan hubungan dengan kandungan kursus induk.

Requirement (EN): Every MC offering must specify assessment methods, criteria, and pass/completion achievement threshold; attendance or participation alone is insufficient for award.
Original wording (BM, short): Setiap penawaran hendaklah menetapkan kaedah, kriteria dan tahap pencapaian yang diperlukan untuk penyempurnaan. Kehadiran atau penyertaan semata-mata... tidak mencukupi.

Requirement (EN): System recognition model must distinguish module-level achievement (Digital Badge) from full MC completion (Certificate / Digital Credential).
Original wording (BM, short): Bentuk pengiktirafan hendaklah membezakan pencapaian pada peringkat modul daripada penyempurnaan keseluruhan Micro-Credential... Sijil atau Digital Credential hendaklah dibezakan daripada Digital Badge.

Requirement (EN): Digital Badge must contain verifiable identification info (module name, LOs, SLT, achievement date, verification link/QR) and clearly communicate that it is NOT academic credit, ACR, or full UMC completion.
Original wording (BM, short): Digital Badge hendaklah mengandungi maklumat yang membolehkan pencapaian dikenal pasti dan disahkan. Digital Badge membuktikan pencapaian modul dan tidak dengan sendirinya merupakan kredit akademik, ACR atau bukti penyempurnaan keseluruhan UMC.

Requirement (EN): For modular UMC, module achievement records and Digital Badges must be retained until all UMC requirements are completed.
Original wording (BM, short): Rekod pencapaian dan Digital Badge, jika berkenaan, hendaklah dikekalkan sehingga keseluruhan keperluan UMC dipenuhi.

Requirement (EN): Accumulating Digital Badges from modules of different UMC/parent courses must NOT automatically assemble a UMC; cross-structure module reuse requires equivalence assessment and academic approval.
Original wording (BM, short): Pengumpulan Digital Badge daripada modul atau kursus induk yang berlainan tidak secara automatik membentuk satu UMC.

Requirement (EN): UMC may ONLY be certified as complete and awarded a Certificate/Digital Credential after ALL modules, LOs, SLT, assessments, and requirements in the UMC structure are fulfilled.
Original wording (BM, short): UMC hanya boleh disahkan sebagai lengkap setelah semua modul, hasil pembelajaran, SLT, pentaksiran dan keperluan lain dalam struktur UMC dipenuhi.

Requirement (EN): For SAMC, Certificate/Digital Credential may ONLY display credit value or MQF level based on official QV decision and prevailing rules.
Original wording (BM, short): Sekiranya SAMC telah memperoleh QV, maklumat berkaitan nilai kredit atau tahap MQF hendaklah dinyatakan hanya berdasarkan keputusan QV dan ketetapan yang berkuat kuasa.

Requirement (EN): MCE Certificate/Digital Credential must represent non-credit learning achievement and must NOT imply academic credit value, MQF level, or credit transfer eligibility.
Original wording (BM, short): Pensijilan MCE tidak boleh memberikan gambaran bahawa penawaran tersebut mempunyai nilai kredit akademik, tahap MQF atau kelayakan untuk pemindahan kredit.

Requirement (EN): Learner achievement record (Rekod Pencapaian Pembelajaran MC UTeM) must identify completed modules, earned Digital Badges, MC completion status, and awarded credentials, distinctly from ACR.
Original wording (BM, short): Rekod pencapaian peserta hendaklah membolehkan UTeM mengenal pasti modul yang telah disempurnakan, Digital Badge yang diperoleh, status penyempurnaan MC serta credential yang telah dianugerahkan... dibezakan daripada ACR.

Requirement (EN): Needs Analysis must identify at least: target group, required competencies/LOs, content relevance, existing equivalent offerings, professional/academic recognition potential, and (for UMC) parent course CLO, SLT, assessment, and programme position.
Original wording (BM, short): Analisis hendaklah sekurang-kurangnya mengenal pasti kumpulan sasaran, kompetensi atau hasil pembelajaran yang diperlukan, kerelevanan kandungan, penawaran setara yang tersedia dan potensi penawaran... Bagi UMC... hubungan dengan kursus induk.

Requirement (EN): MC design must capture offering category, target group, LOs, SLT, content, learning activities, assessment, delivery mode, recognition form, and (for UMC) unbundling model & parent course linkage.
Original wording (BM, short): Reka bentuk MC hendaklah ditentukan berdasarkan analisis keperluan dan merangkumi kategori penawaran, kumpulan sasaran, hasil pembelajaran, SLT, kandungan, aktiviti pembelajaran, pentaksiran, mod penyampaian dan bentuk pengiktirafan.

Requirement (EN): Content development must enforce constructive alignment (LO -> Content -> Activity -> Assessment) and comply with copyright and intellectual property laws for third-party materials.
Original wording (BM, short): Setiap modul hendaklah membentuk pengalaman pembelajaran yang lengkap dengan penjajaran: Hasil Pembelajaran -> Kandungan -> Aktiviti -> Pentaksiran. Penggunaan bahan pihak ketiga hendaklah mematuhi ketetapan hak cipta.

Requirement (EN): Developed MC must pass academic review (verifying LO, constructive alignment, SLT sufficiency, content scope, delivery mode, module structure, credential info, QA compliance, and UMC parent mapping) and resolve review amendments BEFORE submission for approval.
Original wording (BM, short): Micro-Credential yang telah dibangunkan hendaklah melalui semakan sebelum dikemukakan untuk kelulusan... Sebarang pindaan hasil semakan hendaklah diselesaikan sebelum permohonan kelulusan dikemukakan.

Requirement (EN): All MCs must obtain approval through UTeM's designated approving authority BEFORE being offered; approval record must cover justification, category, target group, LOs, module structure, SLT, content, activities, assessment, delivery mode, credential form, and credit recognition if applicable.
Original wording (BM, short): Semua Micro-Credential hendaklah memperoleh kelulusan melalui mekanisme dan pihak berkuasa yang ditetapkan oleh UTeM sebelum ditawarkan.

Requirement (EN): Material changes affecting LO, SLT, assessment, module structure, credit value, parent course linkage, or recognition status must undergo re-review and re-approval.
Original wording (BM, short): Perubahan signifikan (material change) yang menjejaskan hasil pembelajaran, SLT, pentaksiran, struktur modul, nilai kredit, hubungan dengan kursus induk atau status pengiktirafan hendaklah melalui semakan dan kelulusan semula.

Requirement (EN): An MC may ONLY be offered / opened for registration AFTER development, review, and approval are completed and operational readiness (materials, assessment, platform, instructor, registration, records, certification) is in place.
Original wording (BM, short): Micro-Credential hanya boleh ditawarkan setelah proses pembangunan, semakan dan kelulusan disempurnakan. Sebelum pendaftaran dibuka, PTj hendaklah memastikan bahan pembelajaran, pentaksiran, platform...

Requirement (EN): Prospective learner catalogue/info must state at minimum: MC name, LOs, content/modules, SLT, delivery mode, assessment, completion requirements, credential to be received, credit/academic recognition if applicable, and (for modular UMC) module structure, parent UMC relationship, and phased completion rules.
Original wording (BM, short): Maklumat kepada bakal peserta hendaklah jelas dan sekurang-kurangnya menerangkan nama MC, hasil pembelajaran, kandungan atau modul, SLT, mod penyampaian, pentaksiran, syarat penyempurnaan, credential... Bagi UMC modular...

Requirement (EN): All synchronous, asynchronous, face-to-face, and hybrid learning activities must be accounted for in SLT and linked to learning outcomes.
Original wording (BM, short): Semua aktiviti hendaklah diambil kira dalam SLT dan mempunyai hubungan yang jelas dengan hasil pembelajaran.

Requirement (EN): Learning platform must enable learner access to content, activities, assessment, progress tracking, access instructions, and support while complying with UTeM information security and data protection policies.
Original wording (BM, short): Platform pembelajaran hendaklah membolehkan peserta mengakses kandungan, aktiviti, pentaksiran... mematuhi keperluan keselamatan maklumat, perlindungan data.

Requirement (EN): Learner registration, enrolment status, and (for modular UMC) per-module completion status across different periods/cohorts must be systematically recorded.
Original wording (BM, short): Maklumat pendaftaran dan status peserta hendaklah direkodkan secara sistematik... Bagi UMC modular, rekod hendaklah membolehkan status penyempurnaan setiap modul dikenal pasti apabila peserta mengikuti modul pada tempoh yang berbeza.

Requirement (EN): Pre-enrolment transparency page must display: MC category, LOs, SLT, delivery mode, prerequisites, access duration, assessment method & standard, completion requirements, fees, learning support, credential type, and (if applicable) QV status, credit value, and MQF level.
Original wording (BM, short): Sebelum pendaftaran, peserta hendaklah diberikan maklumat yang mencukupi... kategori MC, hasil pembelajaran, SLT, mod penyampaian, prasyarat, tempoh akses, kaedah dan standard pentaksiran, syarat penyempurnaan, yuran, sokongan pembelajaran, credential... status QV, nilai kredit dan tahap MQF.

Requirement (EN): For credit-eligible MCs, pre-enrolment notice must clearly distinguish 5 stages (MC completion, credential award, ACR preparation, ABC deposit, credit transfer approval) and state that none guarantees automatic admission, credit transfer, or qualification award.
Original wording (BM, short): penerangan kepada peserta hendaklah membezakan dengan jelas antara penyempurnaan MC, penganugerahan credential, penyediaan ACR, deposit ke ABC dan kelulusan pemindahan kredit. Tiada satu daripada peringkat tersebut boleh dipersembahkan sebagai jaminan automatik.

Requirement (EN): Changes affecting learning structure, assessment, access duration, credential, QV status, or academic recognition must be notified to affected learners within a reasonable time, stating effective date and transition arrangement for material changes.
Original wording (BM, short): Perubahan yang memberi kesan kepada struktur pembelajaran, pentaksiran, tempoh akses, credential, status QV atau pengiktirafan akademik hendaklah dimaklumkan kepada peserta yang terjejas... menjelaskan tarikh kuat kuasa dan kaedah peralihan.

Requirement (EN): Assessment and achievement records must link learner identity, assessment results, and achievement decision; achievement MUST be verified/confirmed BEFORE any Digital Badge, Certificate, or Digital Credential is issued.
Original wording (BM, short): bukti yang mencukupi hendaklah tersedia untuk menghubungkan identiti peserta, hasil pentaksiran dan keputusan pencapaian. Pencapaian hendaklah disahkan sebelum Digital Badge, Sijil atau Digital Credential dianugerahkan.

Requirement (EN): Full MC Certificate/Digital Credential may ONLY be issued after all completion requirements are satisfied, and must NOT imply credit value, MQF level, or QV status if not officially obtained.
Original wording (BM, short): Sijil atau Digital Credential bagi keseluruhan MC hanya boleh dianugerahkan setelah semua keperluan penyempurnaan dipenuhi... tidak boleh memberi gambaran bahawa sesuatu MC mempunyai nilai kredit, tahap MQF atau status QV sekiranya pengiktirafan tersebut belum diperoleh secara rasmi.

Requirement (EN): Every issued credential must provide an authenticity verification mechanism.
Original wording (BM, short): Credential hendaklah mempunyai maklumat atau mekanisme yang membolehkan kesahihannya disahkan.

Requirement (EN): Credential correction, misstatement remediation, revocation, or replacement must ONLY be performed by an authorized party, logged in an audit trail, and NEVER erase prior records.
Original wording (BM, short): tindakan hendaklah dibuat oleh pihak yang mempunyai bidang kuasa dan direkodkan melalui audit trail. Pembetulan credential tidak boleh menghapuskan rekod tindakan terdahulu.

Requirement (EN): Execution records (registration, module enrolment, learning progress, assessment decisions, module completion, Digital Badge, MC completion, credential) must be kept separate from academic credit records (ACR/ABC).
Original wording (BM, short): Rekod penyempurnaan modul dan Digital Badge hendaklah dibezakan daripada rekod kredit akademik.

Requirement (EN): QA principles: flexibility must not reduce LO quality or credential credibility; PTj ensures measurable LOs, constructive alignment, reasonable SLT, academic integrity, traceable records, and UMC parent-course linkage.
Original wording (BM, short): Fleksibiliti dalam reka bentuk dan pelaksanaan tidak boleh mengurangkan kualiti hasil pembelajaran atau kredibiliti credential... Bagi UMC... hubungan antara modul dengan kursus induk terus dipelihara.

Requirement (EN): SAMC Quality Verification (QV) must be distinct from UTeM internal offering approval and from academic credit transfer approval; QV status must NOT confer automatic credit transfer.
Original wording (BM, short): QV hendaklah dibezakan daripada kelulusan dalaman UTeM... Status QV tidak memberikan pemindahan atau penggunaan kredit secara automatik.

Requirement (EN): SAMC submitted for QV must have at least 40 hours SLT / notional learning time.
Original wording (BM, short): SAMC yang dikemukakan untuk Quality Verification hendaklah mempunyai sekurang-kurangnya 40 jam Student Learning Time (SLT) / notional learning time.

Requirement (EN): SAMC provider must be registered/authorized AND must have at least ONE (1) completed learner cohort (with execution, assessment, and achievement evidence) BEFORE applying for QV.
Original wording (BM, short): Penyedia SAMC hendaklah merupakan entiti berdaftar dan diberi kuasa serta mempunyai sekurang-kurangnya satu (1) kohort peserta yang telah lengkap sebelum SAMC berkenaan dikemukakan untuk QV.

Requirement (EN): SAMC QV validity period must NOT exceed three (3) continuous years.
Original wording (BM, short): Tempoh sah Quality Verification bagi sesuatu SAMC hendaklah berdasarkan keputusan QVC/MQA... dengan tempoh tidak melebihi tiga (3) tahun berterusan.

Requirement (EN): System/PTj must track QV expiry date; once QV status expires, is suspended, revoked, or no longer applies, system MUST cease displaying/claiming 'Quality-Verified' status (and unverified credit/MQF claims) and manage affected records/learners.
Original wording (BM, short): PTj hendaklah memantau tarikh tamat status QV... Apabila status QV tamat, digantung, ditarik balik atau tidak lagi terpakai, UTeM hendaklah menghentikan dakwaan bahawa penawaran tersebut masih berstatus Quality-Verified.

Requirement (EN): Failing QV does not prevent offering the SAMC as a non-credit standalone offering, but it MUST NOT use the Quality-Verified label or be advertised as QV.
Original wording (BM, short): Kegagalan memenuhi kriteria QV tidak menghalang penawaran SAMC, tetapi MC tersebut tidak akan menggunakan label Quality-Verified dan tidak boleh diiklankan sebagai QV.

Requirement (EN): Material changes to a QV-SAMC (LO, SLT/credit, MQF, core content, major assessment/pass standard, delivery mode, provider/partner, identity/integrity controls) must trigger review/re-verification assessment.
Original wording (BM, short): Perubahan signifikan terhadap SAMC yang telah melalui QV hendaklah dinilai untuk menentukan sama ada semakan atau pengesahan semula diperlukan.

Requirement (EN): For QV-SAMC, assessment types, weightings, and pass standards must be clearly stated; Digital Credential MUST display: credential ID, provider, LOs, learning time/SLT, verified credit value & MQF level, assessment results, QV information, and a verification mechanism.
Original wording (BM, short): Bagi SAMC yang telah disahkan kualiti, Digital Credential hendaklah memaparkan maklumat yang diperlukan oleh ketetapan QV, termasuk identiti credential, penyedia, hasil pembelajaran, learning time/SLT, nilai kredit dan tahap MQF yang disahkan, hasil pentaksiran serta maklumat QV.

Requirement (EN): Implementation monitoring must be evidence-based beyond registration counts: LO achievement, assessment performance, content/SLT suitability, participation & completion rates, delivery effectiveness, academic integrity issues, and phased module completion for modular UMC.
Original wording (BM, short): Pemantauan hendaklah berasaskan bukti, khususnya pencapaian hasil pembelajaran, prestasi pentaksiran, kesesuaian kandungan dan SLT, penyertaan serta penyempurnaan... tidak seharusnya tertumpu kepada bilangan pendaftaran semata-mata.

Requirement (EN): CQI actions must be traceable from monitoring findings/evidence -> analysis -> action -> re-evaluation.
Original wording (BM, short): setiap tindakan hendaklah dapat dijejak daripada dapatan kepada analisis, tindakan dan penilaian semula.

Requirement (EN): Periodic review must evaluate LO, content currency, SLT, assessment, learner performance, and industry changes; parent course/programme changes MUST trigger UMC review; outcome must record continue, update, re-review/re-approve, suspend, or terminate.
Original wording (BM, short): Bagi UMC, perubahan kepada kursus atau program induk... hendaklah mencetuskan semakan terhadap UMC yang berkaitan. Hasil semakan hendaklah digunakan untuk menentukan sama ada penawaran diteruskan, dikemas kini, disemak dan diluluskan semula, digantung atau ditamatkan.

Requirement (EN): System must enforce strict stage separation across learning achievement, MC completion, ACR, ABC deposit, and credit usage; accumulation must NEVER automatically grant credit transfer, admission, or qualification.
Original wording (BM, short): hendaklah dibezakan antara pencapaian pembelajaran, penyempurnaan Micro-Credential, ACR, deposit ke ABC dan penggunaan kredit.

Requirement (EN): Accumulated credit records must retain source info, learning outcomes, credit value, learning/MQF level, and linked academic records.
Original wording (BM, short): Kredit yang dikumpulkan hendaklah mengekalkan maklumat sumber, hasil pembelajaran, nilai kredit, tahap pembelajaran dan rekod akademik yang berkaitan.

Requirement (EN): ABC deposit eligibility MUST classify learning source into Formal (accredited-programme UMC) and Non-Formal (ONLY Quality-Verified SAMC); non-QV SAMC and MCE MUST be blocked from ACR/ABC deposit.
Original wording (BM, short): sumber pembelajaran MC hendaklah dibezakan kepada pembelajaran formal (UMC program berakreditasi) dan pembelajaran non-formal (hanya SAMC yang telah melalui QV).

Requirement (EN): For UMC, ALL modules and requirements must be completed before UMC is complete and eligible for ACR; completing one module or holding a Digital Badge does NOT confer full UMC credit, and combining modules from different parent courses does not automatically form a new UMC.
Original wording (BM, short): Bagi UMC, keseluruhan modul dan keperluan... hendaklah disempurnakan sebelum UMC dianggap lengkap. Penyempurnaan satu modul atau pemilikan satu Digital Badge tidak memberikan kredit penuh.

Requirement (EN): For SAMC, full completion of LO, SLT, activities, assessment, AND valid QV status are mandatory for academic credit and ABC deposit; credit value and MQF level must come solely from QV decision.
Original wording (BM, short): Bagi tujuan kredit akademik dan deposit ke ABC, SAMC hendaklah memenuhi keperluan Quality Verification (QV). Nilai kredit dan tahap MQF hendaklah berdasarkan keputusan QV.

Requirement (EN): ACR must be a distinct entity/record separate from internal UTeM Learning Achievement Record (Rekod Pencapaian Pembelajaran MC UTeM), prepared only after full UMC or QV-SAMC completion.
Original wording (BM, short): ACR hendaklah dibezakan daripada Rekod Pencapaian Pembelajaran Micro-Credential UTeM... Setelah semua modul dan keperluan UMC disempurnakan, ACR boleh disediakan.

Requirement (EN): ACR must contain: learner identity, provider, MC/course, learning outcomes, credit value, MQF level, completion date, assessment details, and verification metadata.
Original wording (BM, short): Maklumat hendaklah merangkumi... identiti peserta, penyedia, Micro-Credential atau kursus berkaitan, hasil pembelajaran, nilai kredit, tahap MQF, tarikh penyempurnaan, pentaksiran dan metadata pengesahan.

Requirement (EN): Explicit learner consent / authorization must be obtained and recorded before submitting/depositing ACR to ABC.
Original wording (BM, short): Pihak yang mengemukakan ACR hendaklah memastikan kesahihan, ketepatan dan integriti rekod serta memperoleh persetujuan peserta sebagaimana yang dikehendaki oleh mekanisme ABC.

Requirement (EN): Only eligible ACRs may be deposited into ABC; Digital Badges, Certificates, or incomplete module records MUST NOT be treated or deposited as ABC credits.
Original wording (BM, short): hanya ACR yang memenuhi keperluan deposit boleh dikemukakan ke ABC. Digital Badge, Sijil/Digital Credential atau rekod modul yang belum membentuk kredit akademik tidak boleh dianggap sebagai kredit yang telah didepositkan ke ABC.

Requirement (EN): ABC screens/outputs must clearly communicate that ACR or ABC deposit does NOT grant automatic credit transfer approval; receiving institution retains decision authority.
Original wording (BM, short): Kewujudan ACR atau kredit dalam ABC tidak memberikan kelulusan automatik bagi pemindahan kredit. ABC tidak menentukan kesesuaian kredit untuk pemindahan.

Requirement (EN): Learners may accumulate multiple ACRs from different eligible UMC/QV-SAMC offerings; each ACR must retain its individual identity and academic metadata and must NOT be automatically merged without equivalence assessment.
Original wording (BM, short): Setiap ACR hendaklah mengekalkan identiti dan maklumat akademiknya walaupun dikumpulkan dalam ABC... tidak bermaksud kredit atau modul daripada MC yang berbeza boleh digabungkan secara automatik.

Requirement (EN): Credits from external institutions' MCs may be captured/considered subject to record validity, provider status, accreditation/QV, LO, credit, MQF, SLT, content, assessment, currency of knowledge, and programme suitability; ABC presence does not obligate UTeM acceptance.
Original wording (BM, short): Kredit daripada Micro-Credential institusi lain boleh dipertimbangkan... Kewujudan ACR atau deposit kredit daripada institusi lain dalam ABC tidak mewajibkan UTeM menerima kredit tersebut.

Requirement (EN): Credits deposited in ABC MUST have a validity period of exactly ten (10) years calculated from the ABC deposit date.
Original wording (BM, short): Kredit yang didepositkan ke ABC mempunyai tempoh sah sepuluh (10) tahun daripada tarikh deposit, tertakluk kepada ketetapan ABC yang berkuat kuasa.

Requirement (EN): Expiry of the 10-year credit validity period MUST NOT delete or destroy the ACR; ACR must be retained in perpetuity unless instructed otherwise by the learner (owner) or recognized authority.
Original wording (BM, short): Tamatnya tempoh sah kredit tersebut tidak dengan sendirinya menghapuskan ACR... ACR yang diterima dan diurus dalam ABC dikekalkan secara berterusan (in perpetuity).

Requirement (EN): Credits past the 10-year validity window may still be re-evaluated by the receiving institution for currency of knowledge and academic suitability.
Original wording (BM, short): Sekiranya kredit terdahulu hendak dipertimbangkan selepas tempoh sah kredit, institusi penerima boleh menjalankan penilaian semula termasuk dari aspek currency of knowledge.

Requirement (EN): Single Redemption Principle: credit that has been fully redeemed toward an awarded qualification MUST be permanently blocked from reuse/redemption for any other academic qualification.
Original wording (BM, short): Penggunaan kredit dalam ABC hendaklah mematuhi Prinsip Penebusan Tunggal (Single Redemption Principle). Kredit yang telah digunakan... tidak boleh digunakan semula bagi memenuhi kelayakan akademik yang lain.

Requirement (EN): ABC redemption state machine MUST enforce: Available -> Provisionally Redeemed (upon approved transfer into a programme) -> Redeemed (upon successful programme completion) OR returned to Available (if learner does not complete the programme AND credit is still within its 10-year validity period).
Original wording (BM, short): Kredit yang telah dipindahkan dianggap ditebus sementara (provisionally redeemed)... Setelah program berjaya disempurnakan... ditebus sepenuhnya (redeemed)... Sekiranya peserta tidak berjaya menyempurnakan program tersebut, kredit berkenaan masih boleh tersedia... selagi masih dalam tempoh sah.

Requirement (EN): Redeeming credit MUST NOT delete or invalidate the learner's ACR, Digital Badge, Certificate, or Digital Credential.
Original wording (BM, short): Penebusan kredit tidak menghapuskan ACR atau credential peserta. Digital Badge, Sijil atau Digital Credential boleh terus dikekalkan sebagai bukti pencapaian pembelajaran.

Requirement (EN): Credit accumulation must preserve end-to-end traceability (source record -> MC completion -> ACR -> ABC deposit -> credit usage); discrepancies must be checked against source records and corrected only by authorized parties.
Original wording (BM, short): hubungan antara rekod sumber, penyempurnaan MC, ACR, deposit ke ABC dan penggunaan kredit dapat dijejaki... sebarang pembetulan hendaklah dilaksanakan oleh pihak yang mempunyai bidang kuasa.

Requirement (EN): Credit transfer must be a separate formal academic decision process; MC approval, completion, QV, or ABC deposit must NEVER automatically grant credit transfer.
Original wording (BM, short): Kelulusan penawaran Micro-Credential, penyempurnaan pembelajaran, QV atau deposit ke ABC tidak boleh ditafsirkan sebagai kelulusan pemindahan kredit.

Requirement (EN): Eligible credit sources for credit transfer: UTeM UMC (with verifiable parent course linkage), eligible external UMC, and Quality-Verified SAMC (with verifiable QV status, credit & MQF); MCE MUST be rejected/blocked.
Original wording (BM, short): Kredit boleh dipertimbangkan daripada UMC UTeM, UMC institusi lain yang layak dan Quality-Verified SAMC... MCE tidak membawa kredit akademik dan tidak boleh digunakan secara langsung bagi pemindahan kredit.

Requirement (EN): Academic equivalence evaluation MUST NOT be based solely on credit value or SLT matching; it must evaluate LO, credit value, MQF level, content, SLT, depth, learning activities, assessment method & standard, currency of knowledge, accreditation/QV status, and programme/professional body requirements.
Original wording (BM, short): Kesetaraan akademik tidak boleh ditentukan berdasarkan persamaan nilai kredit atau SLT semata-mata. Penilaian hendaklah mengambil kira hasil pembelajaran, nilai kredit, tahap MQF, kandungan, SLT, kedalaman...

Requirement (EN): Credit transfer workflow must support multi-MC applications with supporting documents and enforce sequence: Application -> Record Validity Check -> Equivalence Evaluation -> Credit Limits & Conditions Check -> Authorized Academic Decision.
Original wording (BM, short): Proses hendaklah merangkumi semakan kesahihan rekod, penilaian kesetaraan, semakan syarat dan had pemindahan kredit serta keputusan akademik oleh pihak yang diberi kuasa.

Requirement (EN): Transferred credits must be validated against prevailing programme and entry pathway credit transfer limits; total ABC credit balance must NOT be used as sole approval basis.
Original wording (BM, short): Jumlah kredit yang boleh dipindahkan hendaklah mematuhi had pemindahan kredit yang berkuat kuasa bagi program dan laluan kemasukan berkenaan.

Requirement (EN): Partial UMC module completion or Digital Badge alone must NOT be accepted for full parent course credit transfer unless a specific module has explicit separate credit unit approval.
Original wording (BM, short): Bagi UMC modular, penyempurnaan sebahagian modul atau pemilikan Digital Badge tidak memberikan kredit penuh bagi kursus induk... kecuali sesuatu modul telah diluluskan secara khusus.

Requirement (EN): Courses or programme components designated as non-transferable must be blocked from fulfilment via credit transfer.
Original wording (BM, short): Kursus atau komponen yang ditetapkan sebagai tidak boleh dipenuhi melalui pemindahan kredit hendaklah disempurnakan mengikut struktur program.

Requirement (EN): Credit transfer decisions must support: accepted/approved, rejected/not accepted, or requires additional evidence/assessment (plus partial approval per F8); credit may ONLY be recorded as used in a programme AFTER formal academic approval.
Original wording (BM, short): Keputusan boleh berupa kredit diterima, tidak diterima atau memerlukan bukti atau penilaian tambahan. Kredit hanya boleh direkodkan sebagai digunakan dalam program setelah kelulusan akademik diperoleh.

Requirement (EN): When a credit transfer application is rejected, original ACR, ABC credit (still Available), Digital Badge, Certificate, and Digital Credential MUST remain intact and valid.
Original wording (BM, short): Sekiranya permohonan tidak diluluskan, ACR, Digital Badge, Sijil atau Digital Credential asal kekal sebagai rekod pencapaian peserta. Penolakan pemindahan kredit tidak membatalkan pencapaian MC yang sah.

Requirement (EN): Every credit transfer decision must be recorded and traceable to credit source, ACR, equivalence assessment, approval decision, and programme academic record, while keeping ABC records distinct from UTeM credit usage records.
Original wording (BM, short): Setiap keputusan pemindahan kredit hendaklah direkodkan dan boleh dijejaki kepada sumber kredit, ACR, penilaian kesetaraan, keputusan kelulusan dan rekod akademik program.

Requirement (EN): Equivalence assessment must reference specific curriculum version and MC version; material changes to LO, content, SLT, assessment, MQF, or programme structure trigger re-evaluation.
Original wording (BM, short): Kesetaraan akademik hendaklah merujuk kepada versi kurikulum dan Micro-Credential yang berkaitan. Perubahan signifikan... boleh menyebabkan kesetaraan terdahulu perlu dinilai semula.

Requirement (EN): Stackable Degree must enforce all 8 principles (a)-(h): eligible credits only, target programme link, Ch. 13 credit transfer approval, credit cap compliance, separate entry qualification check, no auto student status, completion of remaining mandatory components, and graduation criteria.
Original wording (BM, short): Pelaksanaan Stackable Degree hendaklah berasaskan prinsip berikut: (a)-(h)... pengumpulan MC atau kredit dalam ABC merupakan laluan pembelajaran dan bukan penganugerahan kelayakan akademik.

Requirement (EN): Stackable Degree pathways MUST use only credit-bearing credentials; non-credit credentials (MCE, non-QV SAMC) must NOT be counted directly toward graduation credits.
Original wording (BM, short): Laluan Stackable Degree hendaklah dibina daripada credential yang membawa kredit akademik yang boleh dipindahkan (credit-bearing credential).

Requirement (EN): Only completed UMC (or explicitly approved credit-unit modules) and Quality-Verified SAMC (subject to equivalence and credit transfer) may support Stackable Degree pathways.
Original wording (BM, short): UMC... semua modul dan keperluan UMC hendaklah disempurnakan... Quality-Verified SAMC boleh dipertimbangkan... tertakluk kepada penilaian kesetaraan, pemindahan kredit.

Requirement (EN): Programme admission must be evaluated separately from credit transfer; possessing MCs, ACRs, or ABC credits does NOT grant automatic admission; approved credits are applied only after admission.
Original wording (BM, short): Kemasukan ke program akademik hendaklah dinilai secara berasingan daripada pemindahan kredit. Pemilikan MC, ACR atau kredit dalam ABC tidak memberikan kemasukan automatik.

Requirement (EN): Learner must complete all remaining programme requirements (core, elective, project, industrial training, professional components, institutional requirements); accumulated credits cannot waive PLOs or mandatory non-transferable components.
Original wording (BM, short): Jumlah kredit terkumpul tidak boleh digunakan untuk mengetepikan hasil pembelajaran program atau komponen yang ditetapkan sebagai wajib dan tidak boleh dipenuhi melalui pemindahan kredit.

Requirement (EN): At least 30% of total graduation credits MUST be earned directly at UTeM as awarding (home) institution; system must NOT represent the remaining 70% as automatic transfer entitlement.
Original wording (BM, short): sekurang-kurangnya tiga puluh peratus (30%) daripada jumlah kredit bergraduat hendaklah diperoleh secara langsung daripada UTeM... tidak boleh ditafsirkan sebagai kelayakan automatik untuk memindahkan tujuh puluh peratus (70%) kredit.

Requirement (EN): Stacked credits and credentials must be explicitly mapped to Programme Learning Outcomes (PLO) and Body of Knowledge of the target qualification; sufficient credit count alone is inadequate.
Original wording (BM, short): Kredit dan credential yang digunakan untuk membentuk laluan Stackable Degree hendaklah dipetakan kepada hasil pembelajaran program (PLO) dan body of knowledge bagi kelayakan sasaran.

Requirement (EN): Learners graduating via Stackable Degree in a conventional programme MUST fulfill minimum ONE (1) semester residency at UTeM as awarding institution, consistent with approved delivery mode and without bypassing ODL policy.
Original wording (BM, short): Bagi peserta yang akan bergraduat melalui laluan Stackable Degree dalam program konvensional, peserta hendaklah memenuhi keperluan residensi minimum satu (1) semester di UTeM.

Requirement (EN): Stackable Degree implementation must remain aligned with approved programme mode (Conventional vs ODL); using MCs or online delivery must NOT automatically convert a conventional programme to ODL; substantive mode shifts require ODL policy/QA approval.
Original wording (BM, short): Penggunaan MC, pembelajaran fleksibel atau kaedah penyampaian dalam talian... tidak boleh ditafsirkan sebagai mengubah mod penyampaian atau status program secara automatik... tertakluk kepada dasar, standard, kelulusan dan mekanisme jaminan kualiti ODL.

Requirement (EN): Stackable Degree pathway mapping must display MC, parent course, target programme, LO, credit value, MQF level, SLT, assessment, and curriculum position, while clearly distinguishing mapping from credit transfer approval.
Original wording (BM, short): Laluan Stackable Degree hendaklah mempunyai pemetaan yang jelas antara MC, kursus induk dan program akademik sasaran... Pemetaan tidak sama dengan pemindahan kredit.

Requirement (EN): When curriculum changes or currency of knowledge re-evaluation changes equivalence outcome (still equivalent / needs supplementary learning / no longer equivalent), original credential and ACR must remain preserved.
Original wording (BM, short): Walaupun keputusan kesetaraan berubah, credential dan ACR asal kekal sebagai rekod pencapaian pembelajaran peserta.

Requirement (EN): Stackable Degree information to learners must disclose target programme, MC mapping, entry requirements, credit transfer process, credit caps, credit validity, remaining programme, and graduation requirements, and MUST NEVER imply that collecting a certain number of MCs/badges/credits automatically produces a degree.
Original wording (BM, short): Sebarang promosi tidak boleh menyatakan atau memberi gambaran bahawa bilangan tertentu MC, Digital Badge atau kredit yang dikumpulkan akan menghasilkan sesuatu ijazah secara automatik.

Requirement (EN): Academic qualification may ONLY be awarded after lawful admission to the target programme AND fulfilment of all programme and graduation requirements.
Original wording (BM, short): Kelayakan akademik hanya boleh dianugerahkan setelah peserta diterima secara sah ke program akademik dan memenuhi semua keperluan program serta syarat graduasi.

Requirement (EN): Governance spans the full MC lifecycle based on accountability, compliance, transparency, segregation of duties, academic/data integrity, QA, and learner protection.
Original wording (BM, short): Pelaksanaan tadbir urus hendaklah berasaskan akauntabiliti, pematuhan, ketelusan, pengasingan fungsi... Setiap peringkat hendaklah mempunyai pihak bertanggungjawab, mekanisme semakan atau kelulusan serta rekod.

Requirement (EN): Three governance tiers (University, Faculty/PTj, Operations/Support); operations/support roles MUST NOT usurp academic decision-making authority.
Original wording (BM, short): Fungsi operasi hendaklah menyokong pelaksanaan akademik tanpa mengambil alih kuasa keputusan akademik yang ditetapkan kepada pihak berkuasa berkaitan.

Requirement (EN): MC offering approval must be segregated from academic credit value/transfer approval decisions.
Original wording (BM, short): Kelulusan Micro-Credential untuk ditawarkan hendaklah dibezakan daripada keputusan berkaitan nilai atau penggunaan kredit akademik.

Requirement (EN): Record & credential governance defines record ownership, access rights, verification, and category-specific oversight (UMC parent linkage, SAMC QV, MCE internal QA).
Original wording (BM, short): Tadbir urus hendaklah memastikan pemilikan rekod, kuasa akses, tanggungjawab pengesahan dan kebolehkesanan ditetapkan dengan jelas.

Requirement (EN): All decisions affecting offering status, learner achievement, credential, credit value, or credit usage MUST record source record, decision-maker, and action date; corrections to academic/achievement records require audit trail and authorized role.
Original wording (BM, short): Semua keputusan yang memberi kesan kepada status penawaran, pencapaian peserta, credential, nilai kredit atau penggunaan kredit hendaklah mempunyai rekod sumber, pihak yang membuat keputusan dan tarikh tindakan.

Requirement (EN): Inter-party coordination to reconcile discrepancies between approved design, delivery, assessment, credentials, and academic records against official records.
Original wording (BM, short): Ketidakselarasan antara reka bentuk yang diluluskan, pelaksanaan, keputusan pentaksiran, credential atau rekod akademik hendaklah disemak berdasarkan rekod rasmi dan diperbetulkan.

Requirement (EN): University sets policies/standards/oversight; Faculty/PTj owns offerings within its expertise and submits material changes through formal review/approval.
Original wording (BM, short): Universiti bertanggungjawab menetapkan dasar... Fakulti atau PTj bertanggungjawab terhadap penawaran di bawah bidang kepakaran masing-masing.

Requirement (EN): MC Coordinator coordinates development, delivery, and records, and MUST be prevented from making academic decisions outside delegated authority.
Original wording (BM, short): Penyelaras tidak boleh membuat keputusan akademik di luar kuasa yang diberikan kepadanya.

Requirement (EN): Developer prepares aligned design/materials (proving parent linkage for UMC); Instructor/Facilitator delivers and assesses per approved design and gives CQI feedback.
Original wording (BM, short): Pembangun bertanggungjawab menyediakan reka bentuk pembelajaran... Tenaga pengajar atau fasilitator hendaklah melaksanakan pembelajaran dan pentaksiran berdasarkan reka bentuk yang diluluskan.

Requirement (EN): Assessor/Reviewer conducts objective review; conflicts of interest MUST be managed/prevented (e.g., preventing self-review/self-approval of one's own MC).
Original wording (BM, short): Penilai atau penyemak hendaklah membuat semakan secara objektif... Sebarang konflik kepentingan hendaklah diurus mengikut ketetapan UTeM yang berkuat kuasa.

Requirement (EN): Industry / External SME may contribute competency and market input without replacing UTeM academic responsibility.
Original wording (BM, short): Industri atau pakar luar / SME boleh dilibatkan bagi memberi input... tanpa menggantikan tanggungjawab akademik UTeM.

Requirement (EN): Learner provides accurate data, complies with academic integrity, provides consent/authorization for ACR/ABC/credit transfer, and acknowledges non-automatic credit transfer or programme admission.
Original wording (BM, short): Bagi urusan ACR, ABC atau pemindahan kredit, peserta hendaklah memberikan maklumat atau persetujuan yang diperlukan dan memahami bahawa penyempurnaan MC tidak memberikan pemindahan kredit atau kemasukan program secara automatik.

Requirement (EN): General Governance Function Matrix (Jadual 2) and inter-stakeholder reconciliation with audit trail.
Original wording (BM, short): Jadual 2: Matriks Fungsi Umum Tadbir Urus Micro-Credential UTeM... Tindakan pembetulan hendaklah mempunyai audit trail.

Requirement (EN): Monitoring & CQI must track quantitative and qualitative data across enrolment, completion, LO achievement, assessment outcomes, content/SLT suitability, delivery, integrity, platform usability, learner support, feedback, credentials, record accuracy, and cross-module/cross-period progress for modular UMC.
Original wording (BM, short): Pemantauan boleh merangkumi enrolmen, kadar penyempurnaan, pencapaian LO, keputusan pentaksiran... Bagi UMC modular, pemantauan hendaklah membolehkan kemajuan peserta merentas modul dan tempoh yang berbeza dikenal pasti.

Requirement (EN): Learner and stakeholder (instructor/industry/SME) feedback must be collected and analyzed together with LO achievement and execution evidence before determining CQI actions.
Original wording (BM, short): Maklum balas hendaklah dianalisis bersama pencapaian hasil pembelajaran dan bukti pelaksanaan lain sebelum tindakan CQI ditentukan.

Requirement (EN): LO achievement must serve as primary effectiveness indicator; root causes of unsatisfactory achievement must be identified and addressed rather than merely lowering assessment difficulty.
Original wording (BM, short): Pencapaian hasil pembelajaran hendaklah menjadi indikator utama keberkesanan MC... Tindakan CQI hendaklah menangani punca yang dikenal pasti dan bukan sekadar mengurangkan tahap kesukaran pentaksiran.

Requirement (EN): Every CQI action must maintain traceability chain: Issue/Finding -> Evidence -> Analysis -> Action -> Implementation -> Effectiveness Evaluation.
Original wording (BM, short): Setiap tindakan hendaklah mempunyai kebolehkesanan yang jelas: Isu/Dapatan -> Bukti -> Analisis -> Tindakan -> Pelaksanaan -> Penilaian Keberkesanan.

Requirement (EN): System must differentiate minor changes (standard update) from material changes (affecting LO, SLT, assessment, credit, MQF, UMC structure, or QV status), which MUST undergo re-review and re-approval (and QV review for QV-SAMC) before execution.
Original wording (BM, short): Perubahan kecil... Perubahan signifikan (material change) yang menjejaskan komponen akademik utama hendaklah melalui semakan dan kelulusan semula yang berkaitan sebelum dilaksanakan.

Requirement (EN): Every material change must be recorded via version control identifying old vs new structure, effective date, key changes, approval decision, and implications for currently enrolled learners.
Original wording (BM, short): Setiap perubahan signifikan hendaklah direkodkan melalui pengurusan versi... menyatakan tarikh kuat kuasa, perubahan utama, keputusan kelulusan dan implikasi kepada peserta yang sedang mengikuti penawaran.

Requirement (EN): Periodic review must record decision outcome: continue, update, require re-approval, suspend, or terminate.
Original wording (BM, short): Semakan hendaklah menentukan sama ada penawaran diteruskan, dikemas kini, memerlukan kelulusan semula, digantung atau ditamatkan.

Requirement (EN): Upon suspension, termination, or version replacement, PTj MUST record a learner transition plan (completion window, new-version mapping, or equivalence assessment) AND notify affected learners of status, transition options, action deadline, and credential/credit implications.
Original wording (BM, short): PTj hendaklah menentukan dan merekodkan mekanisme peralihan yang sesuai... Peserta yang terjejas hendaklah dimaklumkan mengenai status penawaran, pilihan peralihan, tempoh tindakan dan implikasi.

Requirement (EN): CQI cycle may ONLY be closed/marked complete AFTER post-implementation effectiveness has been evaluated; ineffective actions MUST trigger follow-up actions.
Original wording (BM, short): Penambahbaikan hanya dianggap lengkap apabila keberkesanan tindakan telah dinilai. Sekiranya tindakan tidak mencapai hasil yang dikehendaki, tindakan susulan hendaklah dikenal pasti dan dilaksanakan.

Requirement (EN): System must maintain all 10 required record categories (a)-(j): development/approval/versions, execution/enrolment, assessment/achievement, badges/certs/credentials, SAMC QV, internal MC achievement record, ACR/ABC/redemption, credit transfer/equivalence, monitoring/CQI/versions, suspension/termination/transition.
Original wording (BM, short): Rekod hendaklah merangkumi, mengikut kesesuaian: (a) rekod pembangunan dan kelulusan... hingga (j) rekod penggantungan, penamatan atau peralihan penawaran.

Requirement (EN): Internal UTeM MC Learning Achievement Record must NOT be equated with ACR or displayed as evidence of ABC deposit or programme credit acceptance.
Original wording (BM, short): Rekod ini tidak boleh disamakan dengan ACR dan tidak boleh dianggap sebagai bukti bahawa kredit telah didepositkan ke ABC atau diterima dalam sesuatu program akademik.

Requirement (EN): Every Digital Badge, Certificate, or Digital Credential must store credential ID, learner, MC/module, award date, and validity status; corrections/revocations/replacements MUST keep audit trail without erasing prior action records.
Original wording (BM, short): Setiap Digital Badge, Sijil atau Digital Credential... hendaklah mempunyai rekod... Sekiranya credential dibetulkan, dibatalkan atau diganti, perubahan tersebut hendaklah mempunyai audit trail dan tidak boleh menghapuskan rekod tindakan terdahulu.

Requirement (EN): ACR must be distinct from internal UTeM records; ABC deposit record must track credit status, deposit date, and usage/redemption actions, and MUST NEVER display an ABC deposit as approved credit transfer.
Original wording (BM, short): ACR hendaklah dibezakan daripada rekod dalaman UTeM... Deposit ke ABC tidak boleh direkodkan atau dipaparkan sebagai pemindahan kredit yang telah diluluskan.

Requirement (EN): Credit transfer records must capture credit source, linked ACR, equivalence assessment result, approval decision, accepted credits, and programme curriculum usage, enabling verification of credit caps and Single Redemption Principle.
Original wording (BM, short): Rekod pemindahan kredit hendaklah mengandungi sumber kredit, ACR yang berkaitan, hasil penilaian kesetaraan, keputusan kelulusan, kredit yang diterima dan penggunaannya... membolehkan pematuhan kepada had pemindahan kredit dan Prinsip Penebusan Tunggal disahkan.

Requirement (EN): Every MC version must be identifiable with change log (component changed, reason, effective date, approval decision, implications); old versions linked to learner records MUST NOT be deleted.
Original wording (BM, short): Setiap versi MC hendaklah boleh dikenal pasti... Versi lama yang masih berkaitan dengan rekod peserta tidak boleh dipadam sehingga keperluan penyimpanan rekod dipenuhi.

Requirement (EN): CQI records linking monitoring findings -> analysis -> action -> implementation -> effectiveness evaluation must be stored and retrievable for review, audit, QV, or QA.
Original wording (BM, short): Rekod CQI hendaklah menghubungkan dapatan pemantauan dengan analisis, tindakan, pelaksanaan dan penilaian keberkesanan... tersedia bagi tujuan semakan akademik, audit, QV atau jaminan kualiti.

Requirement (EN): Record corrections must be restricted to authorized parties, recorded in an audit trail showing original record, reason, action, approving/executing party, and date; if learner-facing records (credential/ACR/credit status) are impacted, affected learner MUST be notified and related records synchronized.
Original wording (BM, short): Pembetulan hendaklah dibuat oleh pihak yang mempunyai bidang kuasa dan direkodkan melalui audit trail yang menunjukkan rekod asal, sebab pembetulan, tindakan, pihak yang meluluskan atau melaksanakan serta tarikh perubahan... peserta hendaklah dimaklumkan.

Requirement (EN): Role-based access control must restrict record access by authority and protect learner data from loss, unauthorized modification, or unauthorized disclosure.
Original wording (BM, short): Akses kepada rekod hendaklah dikawal berdasarkan kuasa dan tanggungjawab... dilindungi daripada kehilangan, perubahan tanpa kuasa, pendedahan tidak sah.

Requirement (EN): Retention and disposal must distinguish credit validity period from ACR/institutional retention period; disposal prohibited until retention expires and records are no longer needed for audit/QA/recognition/legal/learner protection.
Original wording (BM, short): Tempoh sah kredit hendaklah dibezakan daripada tempoh pengekalan ACR dan rekod institusi. Pelupusan hanya boleh dilakukan selepas tempoh penyimpanan tamat.

Requirement (EN): When an MC offering is suspended or terminated, all offering, learner, achievement, credential, transition decision, and equivalence records must remain preserved; termination MUST NOT cancel valid prior learner achievements.
Original wording (BM, short): Sekiranya MC digantung atau ditamatkan, rekod penawaran, peserta, pencapaian, credential, keputusan peralihan dan kesetaraan terdahulu hendaklah terus diselenggara... Penamatan penawaran tidak membatalkan pencapaian sah.

Requirement (EN): System must reconstruct full end-to-end traceability: Development -> Approval -> Offering -> Learning -> Assessment -> Achievement -> Credential -> ACR/ABC -> Credit Transfer/Usage -> Monitoring & CQI, keeping each record layer non-interchangeable.
Original wording (BM, short): pengurusan rekod hendaklah membolehkan hubungan berikut dijejak: Pembangunan -> Kelulusan -> Penawaran -> Pembelajaran -> Pentaksiran -> Pencapaian -> Credential -> ACR/ABC -> Pemindahan/Penggunaan Kredit -> Pemantauan dan CQI.

Requirement (EN): Ten statutory, MQA (MQF 2nd Ed, GGP MC, GGP QV SAMC, ABC Guidelines, Stackable Degree Guidelines, COPPA:ODL), and UTeM policy references; latest prevailing rules take precedence.
Original wording (BM, short): Senarai 10 rujukan rasmi Akta 679, MQA dan dasar UTeM.

Requirement (EN): Proposal basic info fields: MC Title, PTj/Faculty, Coordinator/Academic Owner, Category (UMC/SAMC/MCE), Proposal Status (Baharu/Semakan/Penawaran Semula), Field/Discipline, Target Group, Delivery Mode (Bersemuka/Dalam Talian/Teradun/Lain-lain), Delivery Language, Proposed Offering Duration.
Original wording (BM, short): A1. Maklumat Asas Penawaran: Tajuk MC, PTj/Fakulti, Penyelaras, Kategori (UMC/SAMC/MCE), Status Cadangan (Baharu/Semakan/Penawaran Semula), Bidang, Kumpulan Sasaran, Mod Penyampaian, Bahasa, Cadangan Tempoh.

Requirement (EN): Needs & Justification fields: Need/Problem addressed, Evidence of Need options (Analisis industri/majikan, Maklum balas peserta, Keperluan program, Standard profesional, Perubahan teknologi, Lain-lain), Value-add over existing courses/training.
Original wording (BM, short): A2. Asas dan Justifikasi Pembangunan: Keperluan/Masalah, Bukti Keperluan (6 pilihan), Nilai Tambah Penawaran.

Requirement (EN): Category Determination: proposed category decision (UMC/SAMC/MCE) and explicit Category Justification.
Original wording (BM, short): A3. Penentuan Kategori Micro-Credential: Keputusan kategori yang dicadangkan (UMC/SAMC/MCE) dan Justifikasi.

Requirement (EN): UMC Additional Info (when category=UMC): Parent Programme, Parent Course Code & Name, Programme Accreditation Status, Parent Course Credits, Parent Course Total SLT, Unbundling Model (Berasaskan Kredit / Berasaskan Topik / Pembelajaran dan Pentaksiran Berasingan), Number of UMC Modules, Confirmation checkbox that module SLT sum matches parent course.
Original wording (BM, short): A4. Maklumat Tambahan bagi UMC: Program Induk, Kod & Nama Kursus Induk, Status Akreditasi Program, Kredit & Jumlah SLT Kursus Induk, Model Penyahhimpunan (3 pilihan), Bilangan Modul, Pengesahan Jumlah SLT.

Requirement (EN): Learning Design matrix: per-row Learning Outcome, Key Content, Learning Activities, Assessment, SLT + Total SLT, Proposed Credit Value (if applicable), Verified MQF Level (only if applicable & verified).
Original wording (BM, short): A5. Reka Bentuk Pembelajaran: Hasil Pembelajaran, Kandungan Utama, Aktiviti Pembelajaran, Pentaksiran, SLT, Jumlah SLT keseluruhan, Cadangan nilai kredit, Tahap MQF.

Requirement (EN): Assessment & Completion Standard fields: Assessment Method, Weighting, Passing/Completion Standard, Identity Verification/Integrity Mechanism, Learner Feedback Mechanism.
Original wording (BM, short): A6. Pentaksiran dan Standard Penyempurnaan: Kaedah Pentaksiran, Pemberatan, Standard Lulus/Penyempurnaan, Pengesahan Identiti/Integriti, Maklum Balas kepada Peserta.

Requirement (EN): Credential & Recognition fields: Credential Awarded (Digital Badge / Sijil / Digital Credential / Lain-lain), Achievement Level (Modul/unit pembelajaran / Keseluruhan MC), SAMC QV Status (Tidak dipohon / Akan dipohon / Quality-Verified / TB), Credit Value/MQF Level (only if verified/approved), Credential Verification Method.
Original wording (BM, short): A7. Credential dan Pengiktirafan: Credential yang Diberikan, Tahap Pencapaian, Status QV bagi SAMC (4 pilihan), Nilai Kredit/Tahap MQF, Kaedah Verifikasi Credential.

Requirement (EN): Delivery Readiness checklist (7 items, each Ya/Belum/TB + Notes/Evidence): materials ready & reviewed, platform ready, assessment & rubric ready, instructor identified, learner info & terms clear, record & credential mechanism ready, accessibility/support considered.
Original wording (BM, short): A8. Kesediaan Pelaksanaan: 7 perkara semakan (Ya/Belum/TB + Catatan/Evidens).

Requirement (EN): 3-stage Review & Approval sign-off table (Academic/Technical Review, PTj/Faculty Endorsement, UTeM Authority Approval), each recording real Name/Position, Decision (Sokong / Pinda / Tidak Sokong), Date, and Remarks.
Original wording (BM, short): A9. Semakan dan Kelulusan: 3 peringkat (Semakan Akademik/Teknikal, Pengesahan PTj/Fakulti, Kelulusan Kuasa UTeM) dengan Nama/Jawatan, Keputusan (Sokong/Pinda/Tidak Sokong), Tarikh, Catatan.

Requirement (EN): Document & Change Control: Document Number/Version, Effective Date, Change Summary, Is Material Change (Ya/Tidak), Affected Components (7+ checkboxes), Follow-up Action (Semakan dalaman / Kelulusan semula / Semakan/QV semula / Lain-lain).
Original wording (BM, short): A10. Kawalan Dokumen dan Perubahan: Nombor/Versi, Tarikh Kuat Kuasa, Ringkasan Perubahan, Adakah Perubahan Signifikan (Ya/Tidak), Komponen Terjejas, Tindakan Susulan.

Requirement (EN): Proposal/approval form and print template must display Nota Penting distinguishing MC offering approval, credential award, ACR, ABC deposit, and credit transfer (no automatic cascade).
Original wording (BM, short): NOTA PENTING: Kelulusan penawaran MC, penganugerahan credential, penyediaan ACR, deposit ke ABC dan pemindahan kredit merupakan proses yang berbeza.

Requirement (EN): Offering & Cohort Info: MC Title, Category (UMC/SAMC/MCE), PTj/Faculty, Coordinator, Cohort/Session, Start-End Dates, Delivery Mode (Bersemuka/Dalam Talian/Teradun), SAMC QV Status (Tidak Berkenaan / Sah hingga: date / Dalam proses).
Original wording (BM, short): B1. Maklumat Penawaran dan Kohort: Tajuk MC, Kategori, PTj/Fakulti, Penyelaras, Kohort/Sesi, Tarikh Mula-Tamat, Mod Penyampaian, Status QV bagi SAMC.

Requirement (EN): Pre-Registration Information Transparency Checklist (10 items, each Ya/Belum/TB + Notes/Evidence, including non-automatic credit transfer notice).
Original wording (BM, short): B2. Ketelusan Maklumat Sebelum Pendaftaran: 10 perkara semakan (Ya/Belum/TB + Catatan/Evidens).

Requirement (EN): Materials, Platform & Access Readiness Checklist (8 items, each Ya/Belum/TB + Notes/Evidence).
Original wording (BM, short): B3. Kesediaan Bahan, Platform dan Akses: 8 perkara semakan (Ya/Belum/TB + Catatan/Evidens).

Requirement (EN): Assessment & Integrity Readiness Checklist (7 items, each Ya/Belum/TB + Notes/Evidence, covering instruments, rubrics, submission dates, identity verification by risk, academic integrity controls, result recording, achievement verifier).
Original wording (BM, short): B4. Kesediaan Pentaksiran dan Integriti: 7 perkara semakan (Ya/Belum/TB + Catatan/Evidens).

Requirement (EN): Learner & Achievement Record schema tracking all 10 elements: Learner Identity, Registration & Cohort, Access/Participation, Activity/Module Completion (mandatory for modular UMC), Assessment Marks/Results, Pass/Completion Decision, Digital Badge per module, Certificate/Digital Credential, ACR info (eligible MCs), ABC deposit status.
Original wording (BM, short): B5. Rekod Peserta dan Pencapaian: 10 elemen rekod termasuk Identiti, Pendaftaran/Kohort, Penyempurnaan modul, Markah, Keputusan lulus, Digital Badge, Sijil/Digital Credential, ACR, Status deposit ABC.

Requirement (EN): Completion & Credential Issuance Checklist (8 items, each Ya/Belum/TB + Notes/Evidence).
Original wording (BM, short): B6. Proses Penyempurnaan dan Pengeluaran Credential: 8 perkara semakan (Ya/Belum/TB + Catatan/Evidens).

Requirement (EN): Change Notification & Learner Protection Checklist (5 items, each Ya/Belum/TB + Notes/Evidence).
Original wording (BM, short): B7. Makluman Perubahan dan Perlindungan Peserta: 5 perkara semakan (Ya/Belum/TB + Catatan/Evidens).

Requirement (EN): Pre-Offering Readiness Sign-Off by 3 roles (MC Coordinator, PTj/Faculty Rep, Support/System Party if applicable) with Name/Position, Status (Sedia / Bersyarat / Belum Sedia), Date, Remarks + Nota Penting that readiness check is NOT new academic approval.
Original wording (BM, short): B8. Pengesahan Kesediaan Sebelum Penawaran (3 peranan: Sedia/Bersyarat/Belum Sedia) + NOTA PENTING kesediaan operasi bukan kelulusan akademik baharu.

Requirement (EN): CQI Offering & Monitoring Period Info: MC Title, Category, PTj/Faculty, Coordinator, Cohort/Session, Execution Period, Enrolled Count, Completed Count, CQI Review Date.
Original wording (BM, short): C1. Maklumat Penawaran dan Tempoh Pemantauan (9 medan termasuk Bilangan Berdaftar, Bilangan Menyempurnakan, Tarikh Semakan CQI).

Requirement (EN): Cohort Performance Summary (6 indicators with Actual, Target/Benchmark, Status Capai/Tidak or Ada/Tiada, Remarks): active participation rate, completion rate, pass/achievement rate, mean/median score, credential issuance rate, significant access/technical issues.
Original wording (BM, short): C2. Ringkasan Prestasi Kohort: 6 indikator (Kadar penyertaan aktif, penyempurnaan, lulus, purata/median, pengeluaran credential, isu akses/teknikal).

Requirement (EN): LO Achievement Analysis table: LO, Assessment Method/Evidence, Achievement Finding (%), Interpretation/Gap + overall summary.
Original wording (BM, short): C3. Analisis Pencapaian Hasil Pembelajaran: Hasil Pembelajaran, Kaedah Pentaksiran/Evidens, Dapatan Pencapaian, Interpretasi/Jurang, Rumusan.

Requirement (EN): Learner & Stakeholder Feedback summary across 4 sources (Learners, Instructors/Facilitators, Industry/Employers/Professionals, System Data/Operational Records) with Aspect, Key Findings, Issues/Strengths, Initial Action.
Original wording (BM, short): C4. Maklum Balas Peserta dan Pihak Berkepentingan (4 sumber: Peserta, Pengajar/Fasilitator, Industri/Majikan/Profesional, Data sistem).

Requirement (EN): Implementation Quality Monitoring across 8 domains (LO alignment, SLT adequacy, materials/activities, assessment validity/reliability, integrity/identity, platform/support, record/credential accuracy, QV/credit/MQF status) with Status (Memuaskan / Perlu Tindakan / TB) and Evidence/Reference.
Original wording (BM, short): C5. Pemantauan Kualiti Pelaksanaan: 8 domain dengan Dapatan, Status (Memuaskan/Perlu Tindakan/TB) dan Evidens/Rujukan.

Requirement (EN): Issues, Root Cause Analysis & Priority table: Issue/Gap, Evidence, Root Cause, Impact, Priority (Tinggi / Sederhana / Rendah).
Original wording (BM, short): C6. Isu, Analisis Punca dan Tahap Keutamaan: Isu/Jurang, Evidens, Punca Utama, Impak, Keutamaan (Tinggi/Sederhana/Rendah).

Requirement (EN): CQI Action Plan table: Improvement Action, Action Owner, Target Date, Success Indicator, Status (Belum / Proses / Selesai).
Original wording (BM, short): C7. Pelan Tindakan CQI: Tindakan Penambahbaikan, Pemilik Tindakan, Tempoh/Tarikh Siap, Indikator Kejayaan, Status (Belum/Proses/Selesai).

Requirement (EN): CQI Effectiveness Evaluation table: CQI Action, Post-Implementation Evidence, Before/After Comparison, Decision (Berkesan / Sebahagian / Tidak Berkesan), Next Action; ineffective actions carried to next cycle.
Original wording (BM, short): C8. Penilaian Keberkesanan CQI: Tindakan CQI, Bukti Selepas, Perbandingan Sebelum/Selepas, Keputusan (Berkesan/Sebahagian/Tidak Berkesan), Tindakan Seterusnya.

Requirement (EN): Offering Review Decision: 5 decision options (Teruskan tanpa perubahan signifikan, Teruskan dengan CQI kecil, Semakan kandungan/pentaksiran diperlukan, Perlu semakan/kelulusan semula, Pertimbang penggantungan/penamatan), Is Material Change (Ya/Tidak), Affected Components (8 checkboxes), Implications for Existing Learners, Follow-up Actions.
Original wording (BM, short): C9. Keputusan Semakan Penawaran: 5 pilihan keputusan, Perubahan Signifikan (Ya/Tidak), 8 Komponen Terjejas, Implikasi Peserta Sedia Ada, Tindakan Susulan.

Requirement (EN): CQI Sign-Off by 3 roles (MC Coordinator, PTj/Faculty Rep, QA/Authority Party with Disahkan/TB, Name/Position, Date, Remarks) + Nota Penting (evidence-based beyond satisfaction scores; material changes need re-approval/re-QV).
Original wording (BM, short): C10. Pengesahan dan Rekod CQI (3 peranan) + NOTA PENTING CQI berasaskan evidens dan perubahan signifikan perlu kelulusan/QV semula.

Requirement (EN): SAMC & QV Application Status header: SAMC Title, Provider/PTj, Coordinator/Academic Owner, Field/Discipline, Total SLT/Notional Learning Time, Proposed Credit Value, Proposed MQF Level, Completed Evidence Cohort, QVC/QV Mechanism, Status (Semakan dalaman / Sedia dikemukakan / Dalam proses QV / QV diperoleh).
Original wording (BM, short): D1. Maklumat SAMC dan Status Permohonan: 10 medan termasuk Kohort Lengkap Evidens, QVC dirujuk, Status (4 pilihan).

Requirement (EN): Basic SAMC Eligibility for QV Checklist (6 items, Ada/Belum/TB + File Ref + Remarks): standalone offering, >=40h SLT, registered/authorized provider, >=1 completed cohort, cohort evidence, proposed credit/MQF justified & NOT displayed as verified pre-QV.
Original wording (BM, short): D2. Kelayakan Asas SAMC untuk QV: 6 item semakan (Ada/Belum/TB + Rujukan Fail/Pautan + Catatan).

Requirement (EN): Academic Design Evidence Checklist for QV (8 items, Ada/Belum/TB + File Ref + Remarks): purpose/target/prereqs, measurable LOs, LO-to-content mapping, content sequence, aligned activities, SLT breakdown, credit justification, MQF level justification.
Original wording (BM, short): D3. Evidens Reka Bentuk Akademik: 8 item semakan (Ada/Belum/TB + Rujukan Fail/Pautan + Catatan).

Requirement (EN): Assessment & Achievement Evidence Checklist for QV (9 items, Ada/Belum/TB + File Ref + Remarks): assessment plan mapped to LO, instruments used, rubrics, weightings & pass standard, learner work samples, complete cohort mark records, LO/performance analysis, identity verification & integrity controls, pre-credential decision verification.
