Original wording (BM, short): D4. Evidens Pentaksiran dan Pencapaian: 9 item semakan (Ada/Belum/TB + Rujukan Fail/Pautan + Catatan).

Requirement (EN): Implementation & Learner Support Evidence Checklist for QV (7 items, Ada/Belum/TB + File Ref + Remarks): pre-enrolment info, materials used, platform/delivery/access proof, learner engagement records, academic/technical support, feedback, execution issues & CQI actions.
Original wording (BM, short): D5. Evidens Pelaksanaan dan Sokongan Peserta: 7 item semakan (Ada/Belum/TB + Rujukan Fail/Pautan + Catatan).

Requirement (EN): QA & CQI Evidence Checklist for QV (9 items, Ada/Belum/TB + File Ref + Remarks): pre-offering review, cohort monitoring, LO analysis, feedback analysis, quality gaps, CQI action plan & owners, CQI implementation proof, CQI effectiveness evaluation, version control.
Original wording (BM, short): D6. Evidens Jaminan Kualiti dan CQI: 9 item semakan (Ada/Belum/TB + Rujukan Fail/Pautan + Catatan).

Requirement (EN): Digital Credential Evidence Checklist for QV (9 items, Ada/Belum/TB + File Ref + Remarks): format ready, credential name & provider, LOs displayed/accessible, SLT shown, credit/MQF shown only if verified, QV info added post-QV, assessment standard identifiable, verification mechanism works, correction/replacement/revocation audit trail.
Original wording (BM, short): D7. Evidens Digital Credential: 9 item semakan (Ada/Belum/TB + Rujukan Fail/Pautan + Catatan).

Requirement (EN): Material Change Review table for QV-SAMC across 9 components (LO, SLT/credit, MQF, core content, major assessment/pass standard, delivery mode, provider/partner, identity/integrity, Digital Credential/QV info) with Ya/Tidak, Description, and Action (Semakan dalaman / Rujuk QVC/MQA / TB).
Original wording (BM, short): D8. Semakan Perubahan Signifikan: 9 komponen dengan Ada Perubahan (Ya/Tidak), Huraian dan Tindakan (Semakan dalaman/Rujuk QVC/MQA/TB).

Requirement (EN): Internal QV Readiness Decision: Overall Decision (Sedia untuk dikemukakan bagi QV / Sedia dengan pembetulan kecil / Belum sedia), Critical Incomplete Evidence, Required Actions, Target QV Submission Date.
Original wording (BM, short): D9. Keputusan Semakan Kesediaan Dalaman (3 pilihan keputusan, Evidens Kritikal Belum Lengkap, Tindakan Diperlukan, Tarikh Sasaran Penyerahan QV).

Requirement (EN): QV Evidence Sign-Off by 3 roles (SAMC Coordinator, PTj/Faculty Rep, QA/Secretariat with Name/Position, Disahkan, Date, Remarks) + Nota Penting (40h SLT / complete evidence / UTeM approval != credit/MQF/QV; QV != automatic credit transfer).
Original wording (BM, short): D10. Pengesahan (3 peranan) + NOTA PENTING pemenuhan 40 jam SLT atau kelulusan dalaman tidak memberikan nilai kredit/MQF/QV.

Requirement (EN): System must maintain functional separation between Digital Badge (module/milestone, non-credit), Sijil/Certificate (full MC completion, no transfer guarantee), and Digital Credential (verifiable digital record displaying credit/MQF only when verified, no transfer guarantee).
Original wording (BM, short): E1. Perbezaan Fungsi Bukti Pencapaian: Digital Badge, Sijil dan Digital Credential mempunyai fungsi yang berbeza dan tidak boleh digunakan secara bertukar ganti.

Requirement (EN): Digital Badge minimum fields: Badge name (module/unit), Parent MC name (if modular UMC), Provider name (UTeM/authorized PTj), Recipient name/identity, Issue date, Achievement criteria, Verification method (URL/ID/QR if official evidence), Credit status (must NOT depict badge as automatic academic credit), plus optional LO metadata.
Original wording (BM, short): E2. Spesifikasi Minimum Digital Badge: Nama badge, Nama MC induk, Nama penyedia, Nama/identiti penerima, Tarikh dikeluarkan, Kriteria pencapaian, Kaedah verifikasi, Status kredit (tidak menggambarkan kredit automatik).

Requirement (EN): Certificate (Sijil) minimum fields: Official UTeM/provider corporate name, Learner name matching official record, Approved MC Title, Category (UMC/SAMC/MCE for clarity), Statement of completion, Award date, Authority endorsement/signatory, Credit/QV/MQF info ONLY if verified & still valid (plus recommended Cert ID & verification method).
Original wording (BM, short): E3. Spesifikasi Minimum Sijil: Nama rasmi UTeM/penyedia, Nama peserta, Tajuk MC, Kategori, Pernyataan penyempurnaan, Tarikh penganugerahan, Nombor/ID sijil, Pengesahan pihak berkuasa, Maklumat kredit/QV/MQF hanya jika sah, Kaedah verifikasi.

Requirement (EN): Digital Credential minimum metadata: Unique Credential ID, Approved Credential Name, Recipient Name & Identity, Provider/Issuer, Issue Date, LOs/Competencies (displayed or linked), Learning Time/SLT, Assessment/Achievement Criteria, Credit Value (ONLY if verified), MQF Level (ONLY if verified), SAMC QV Status (ONLY post-QV matching QVC/MQA), Expiry/Validity Date (when required by QV/mechanism), Verification Mechanism.
Original wording (BM, short): E4. Spesifikasi Minimum Digital Credential: 13 elemen metadata (Credential ID, Nama, Penerima, Issuer, Tarikh, LO, SLT, Pentaksiran, Nilai kredit jika disahkan, Tahap MQF jika disahkan, Status QV, Tarikh tamat/sah, Mekanisme verifikasi).

Requirement (EN): Prohibited vs Permitted Claims enforcement across all 4 categories: (1) UMC — forbid guaranteed transfer/admission claims; (2) SAMC pre-QV — forbid verified credit/MQF claims; (3) QV-SAMC — forbid claiming QV guarantees transfer; (4) MCE — forbid claiming academic credit or direct transfer pathway.
Original wording (BM, short): E5. Kawalan Maklumat Kredit, MQF dan QV: Pernyataan yang Dibenarkan vs Pernyataan yang Perlu Dielakkan bagi UMC, SAMC sebelum QV, Quality-Verified SAMC, dan MCE.

Requirement (EN): Credential Verification Mechanism (Credential ID / URL / QR Code / UTeM system) must display at minimum: credential name, recipient, issuer, issue date, credential status, and permitted metadata, subject to privacy/access controls.
Original wording (BM, short): E6. Mekanisme Verifikasi Credential: Maklumat Minimum Semasa Verifikasi ialah nama credential, penerima, issuer, tarikh, status credential dan maklumat berkaitan yang dibenarkan.

Requirement (EN): Credential lifecycle operations must enforce minimum controls and audit trail: Issuance (verified achievement/identity; logs date, recipient, ID, verifier), Correction (authorized; logs original, reason, correction, actor, date), Replacement (links old/new ID, reason, actor, date), Revocation (authorized; logs revoked status, reason, actor, date).
Original wording (BM, short): E7. Pengeluaran, Pembetulan, Penggantian dan Pembatalan: syarat kawalan minimum dan audit trail bagi keempat-empat tindakan.

Requirement (EN): Pre-Issuance Verification Checklist (8 checks: identity match, all completion terms met, assessment confirmed, credential type matches level, accurate title & category, valid credit/MQF/QV, working ID/verification, issuance record saved).
Original wording (BM, short): E8. Senarai Semak Sebelum Credential Dikeluarkan: 8 perkara semakan (Ya/Tidak/TB + Catatan).

Requirement (EN): Credential spec sign-off (3 roles) + Nota Penting affirming Digital Badge, Sijil/Digital Credential, Internal Achievement Record, ACR, and ABC are distinct and non-interchangeable, and none guarantees automatic credit transfer.
Original wording (BM, short): E10. Pengesahan Spesifikasi Credential + NOTA PENTING: Digital Badge, Sijil/Digital Credential, Rekod Pencapaian Pembelajaran, ACR dan ABC mempunyai fungsi berbeza dan tidak boleh bertukar ganti.

Requirement (EN): Learner & MC Info section: Learner Name, IC/ID, MC Title, Category (ONLY UMC or Quality-Verified SAMC), Provider/Institution, Completion Date, SLT/Notional Learning Time, Eligible Credit Value, MQF Level, SAMC QV Number/Ref & Valid-Until Date.
Original wording (BM, short): F1. Maklumat Peserta dan Micro-Credential: 10 medan; Kategori hanya UMC atau Quality-Verified SAMC.

Requirement (EN): Credit Eligibility Verification Checklist (6 items, Ya/Tidak/TB + Evidence/Ref): MC completed, identity & achievement verified, UMC from accredited course/programme, SAMC has valid QV, credit & MQF based on valid approval/verification, source & credential traceable.
Original wording (BM, short): F2. Pengesahan Kelayakan Kredit untuk Rekod: 6 item semakan (Ya/Tidak/TB + Evidens/Rujukan).

Requirement (EN): ACR Record fields: ACR ID/Ref, ACR Generation Date, Course/Credential Name, Provider/Issuer, Credits Recorded, MQF Level, ACR Status/Notes, Verifying Authority + explicit note distinguishing ACR from Badge/Cert/Internal Record.
Original wording (BM, short): F3. Rekod Academic Credit Record (ACR): 8 medan wajib + nota pembezaan ACR daripada Digital Badge, Sijil dan Rekod Pencapaian Pembelajaran.

Requirement (EN): ABC Deposit fields: Learner Consent/Authorization (Diperoleh + Date), Deposit Date, ABC Deposit Reference, Credits Deposited, Credit Validity Expiry Date (= Deposit Date + 10 years), Deposit Status (exact values: Berjaya / Dalam proses / Pembetulan diperlukan), Authorized Depositor/Party.
Original wording (BM, short): F4. Deposit ke Academic Bank of Credit (ABC): Kebenaran/Autorisasi Peserta + Tarikh, Tarikh Deposit, Rujukan Deposit ABC, Kredit Didepositkan, Tarikh Tamat Tempoh Sah (10 tahun), Status Deposit (Berjaya/Dalam proses/Pembetulan diperlukan), Depositor Diberi Kuasa.

Requirement (EN): Credit Accumulation Ledger table: Row no., ACR/Credential, Provider, Credits, Deposit Date, Credit Status (exact values: Available / Provisionally Redeemed / Redeemed), Total Accumulated Credits + non-automatic acceptance disclaimer.
Original wording (BM, short): F5. Rekod Pengumpulan Kredit: ACR/Credential, Penyedia, Kredit, Tarikh Deposit, Status Kredit (Available / Provisionally Redeemed / Redeemed), Jumlah kredit terkumpul.

Requirement (EN): Credit Transfer Application fields: Target Programme, Receiving Institution, Target Course/Component Applied For, Total Credits Applied For, Application Date, ACR/Credits Used, Supporting Documents checkboxes (ACR, Credential, Hasil Pembelajaran, Kandungan, SLT, Pentaksiran, QV, Lain-lain).
Original wording (BM, short): F6. Permohonan Pemindahan Kredit: Program Sasaran, Institusi Penerima, Kursus/Komponen Dipohon, Jumlah Kredit Dipohon, Tarikh Permohonan, ACR/Kredit Digunakan, Dokumen Sokongan (8 pilihan).

Requirement (EN): Credit Equivalence Assessment Rubric covering ALL 9 criteria with exact allowed values: (1) LO (Setara/Sebahagian/Tidak), (2) Credit & SLT (Sesuai/Tidak), (3) MQF Level (Sesuai/Tidak/TB), (4) Content & Depth (Setara/Sebahagian/Tidak), (5) Learning Activities (Sesuai/Tidak), (6) Assessment & Standard (Sesuai/Tidak), (7) Accreditation/QV (Sah/Tidak/TB), (8) Currency of Knowledge (Memadai/Perlu penilaian lanjut), (9) Programme/Professional Body Req (Dipenuhi/Tidak/TB), each with Findings text.
Original wording (BM, short): F7. Penilaian Kesetaraan Kredit: 9 kriteria dengan Dapatan Penilaian dan skala keputusan khusus bagi setiap kriteria.

Requirement (EN): Credit Transfer Decision fields: Decision (exact allowed values: Diluluskan / Diluluskan sebahagian / Tidak diluluskan), Credits Approved, Target Course/Component Credited, Decision Date, Approving Authority, Conditions/Justification + preservation of ACR/ABC credit on rejection.
Original wording (BM, short): F8. Keputusan Pemindahan Kredit: Keputusan (Diluluskan / Diluluskan sebahagian / Tidak diluluskan), Kredit Diluluskan, Kursus/Komponen Diberi Kredit, Tarikh Keputusan, Pihak/Kuasa Meluluskan, Syarat/Justifikasi.

Requirement (EN): Single Redemption Status history across all 4 lifecycle stages (Before programme use = Available, Transfer approved = Provisionally Redeemed, Programme completed = Redeemed, Programme not completed = subject to ABC mechanism & validity), each with Date and Reference/Notes.
Original wording (BM, short): F9. Status Single Redemption: 4 peringkat (Available, Provisionally Redeemed, Redeemed, Tertakluk mekanisme ABC dan tempoh sah kredit) dengan Tarikh dan Rujukan/Catatan.

Requirement (EN): Corrections & Audit Trail log: Date, Affected Record, Correction Reason, Action Taken, Authority/Executor + rule to sync related records and notify learner.
Original wording (BM, short): F10. Pembetulan dan Audit Trail: Tarikh, Rekod Terjejas, Sebab Pembetulan, Tindakan, Pihak Berkuasa/Pelaksana.

Requirement (EN): Record Confirmation sign-off by 3 real roles (MC Coordinator/Record Owner, Academic/Equivalence Assessor, Authorized Records/ABC Party) with real Name/Position (NOT hardcoded/fabricated), Disahkan/TB, real Date, Remarks + Nota Penting distinguishing the 4 stages (achievement/credential, ACR, ABC deposit, approved transfer).
Original wording (BM, short): F11. Pengesahan Rekod (3 peranan dengan Nama/Jawatan, Pengesahan, Tarikh, Catatan) + NOTA PENTING membezakan 4 peringkat.

Requirement (EN): Target Programme Info: Programme Name, Programme Code, MQF Level, Total Graduation Credits, Approved Programme Mode (Konvensional / ODL / Lain-lain yang diluluskan), Faculty/PTj, Accreditation Status, Intake Cohort/Session.
Original wording (BM, short): G1. Maklumat Program Sasaran: Nama Program, Kod Program, Tahap MQF, Jumlah Kredit Bergraduat, Mod Program Diluluskan (Konvensional/ODL/Lain-lain), Fakulti/PTj, Status Akreditasi, Kohort Kemasukan.

Requirement (EN): Proposed Stacked Credentials/Credits list: Credential/Course/MC, Category/Source (UMC / QV-SAMC / Kelayakan terdahulu / Lain), Provider, Credits, MQF Level, ACR/ABC Status.
Original wording (BM, short): G2. Senarai Credential/Kredit yang Dicadangkan untuk Stacking (Kategori: UMC, QV-SAMC, Kelayakan terdahulu, Lain).

Requirement (EN): Curriculum Structure Mapping table: Source Credential/Credit, Target Course/Component, Credits Applied, LO/Content Equivalence (Tinggi / Sebahagian / Tidak), Preliminary Decision (Sesuai / Perlu semakan / Tidak sesuai).
Original wording (BM, short): G3. Pemetaan kepada Struktur Kurikulum Program: Sumber, Kursus Sasaran, Kredit Dipohon, Kesetaraan LO/Kandungan (Tinggi/Sebahagian/Tidak), Keputusan Awal (Sesuai/Perlu semakan/Tidak sesuai).

Requirement (EN): Programme Learning Outcomes (PLO) Mapping table: Credential/Component, Related PLO, Contribution Level (Utama / Sokongan), Achievement Evidence, Gaps.
Original wording (BM, short): G4. Pemetaan kepada Hasil Pembelajaran Program (PLO): Credential/Komponen, PLO Berkaitan, Tahap Sumbangan (Utama/Sokongan), Evidens Pencapaian, Jurang.

Requirement (EN): Body of Knowledge Mapping table: Programme BoK Domain, Programme Requirement, Contributing Credential/Course, Coverage (Lengkap / Sebahagian / Tiada), Gap/Action.
Original wording (BM, short): G5. Pemetaan kepada Body of Knowledge: Domain/BoK, Keperluan Program, Credential/Kursus Menyumbang, Liputan (Lengkap/Sebahagian/Tiada), Jurang/Tindakan.

Requirement (EN): UTeM Home-Institution Minimum 30% Credit Check: Total Graduation Credits, Minimum 30% UTeM Credits, Direct UTeM Credits Earned, UTeM Credit %, Decision (Memenuhi minimum 30% / Belum memenuhi) + disclaimer that remaining 70% is NOT automatic transfer.
Original wording (BM, short): G6. Semakan Kredit UTeM sebagai Institusi Penganugerah: Jumlah Kredit Bergraduat, Minimum 30% Kredit UTeM, Kredit Langsung UTeM, Peratus Kredit UTeM, Keputusan (Memenuhi minimum 30%/Belum memenuhi).

Requirement (EN): Residency Requirement Check: Programme Mode (Konvensional / ODL / Lain-lain), min 1-semester UTeM residency for Conventional programmes, Proposed Residency Semester, Delivery Method during Residency, Alignment with Approved Mode (Ya / Perlu semakan lanjut) + ODL scope check.
Original wording (BM, short): G7. Semakan Keperluan Residensi: Mod Program, Minimum 1 semester di UTeM bagi Konvensional, Cadangan Semester, Kaedah Penyampaian, Keselarasan Mod (Ya/Perlu semakan lanjut).

Requirement (EN): Remaining Programme Requirements table across 7 component types (Core/mandatory, Electives, Project/capstone/integrative, Industrial training/WBL, University/general, Professional body/standard, Others) with Status (Lengkap / Baki / TB), Fulfillment Method, Credits, Remarks.
Original wording (BM, short): G8. Baki Keperluan Program yang Perlu Disempurnakan: 7 kategori komponen dengan Status (Lengkap/Baki/TB), Kaedah Pemenuhan, Kredit, Catatan.

Requirement (EN): Credit & Gap Analysis Summary: Total Graduation Credits, Credits Proposed from Prior Credentials, Direct UTeM Credits, Credits Approved after Equivalence, Remaining Credits Required, Key Gaps Identified.
Original wording (BM, short): G9. Ringkasan Analisis Kredit dan Jurang: 5 angka kredit dan Jurang utama yang dikenal pasti.

Requirement (EN): Stackable Degree Pathway Eligibility Decision: Overall Decision (Sesuai diteruskan / Sesuai dengan syarat / pemetaan tambahan / Belum sesuai / Tidak sesuai), PLO status, BoK status, Min 30% UTeM status, Residency status, Mode Alignment status, Remaining Requirements, Conditions/Follow-up.
Original wording (BM, short): G10. Keputusan Kelayakan Laluan Stackable Degree: 4 pilihan keputusan + status PLO, BoK, Minimum 30%, Residensi, Keselarasan Mod, Baki Keperluan, Syarat.

Requirement (EN): Mapping Confirmation sign-off by 3 roles (Programme Coordinator, Academic/Faculty Rep, Equivalence/QA Assessor if applicable) with Name/Position, Disahkan/TB, Date, Remarks + Nota Penting (not credit addition alone; >=30% UTeM; >=1 sem residency for conventional).
Original wording (BM, short): G11. Pengesahan Pemetaan (3 peranan) + NOTA PENTING laluan Stackable Degree bukan proses menjumlahkan kredit semata-mata.

Requirement (EN): System RBAC/governance must distinguish and represent the 8 generic roles P1-P8: P1 (MC Coordinator/Academic Owner), P2 (PTj/Faculty), P3 (Academic Authority), P4 (Quality Assurance), P5 (Platform/Technical Support), P6 (Records/Credential Authority), P7 (Authorized ABC Depositor), P8 (Learner/Participant).
Original wording (BM, short): H2. Kategori Peranan Umum: P1 hingga P8 dengan skop akauntabiliti dan tugas berbeza.

Requirement (EN): Lifecycle RACI Matrix enforcement across all 18 lifecycle activities matching Guide Accountable/Responsible assignments (e.g., P3 A for Offering Approval, Credit Transfer Evaluation & Stackable Mapping; P6 A/R for ACR Preparation & R for Credential Issuance; P8 R for ABC Consent; P7 A/R for ABC Deposit; P2 A for Design/Category/Academic Review/Readiness/Delivery/Assessment/CQI/QV/Material Change/Termination).
Original wording (BM, short): H3. Matriks RACI Kitar Hayat Micro-Credential merangkumi 18 aktiviti dan peranan P1-P8.

Requirement (EN): Record Ownership Matrix covering 12 record classes with designated Owner/Custodian, Creator, Retention Method/Duration, and Access Level.
Original wording (BM, short): H4. Matriks Pemilikan Rekod bagi 12 jenis rekod dengan Pemilik/Penjaga, Sumber/Pencipta, Tempoh/Kaedah Simpanan, Akses.

Requirement (EN): Minimum Cohort Records Checklist tracking 10 mandatory artefacts per cohort (registered list, versioned materials/structure, participation records, assessment instruments & results, completion verification evidence, issued credentials, feedback & monitoring, CQI & follow-up, ACR/ABC for eligible learners, changes/corrections/incidents).
Original wording (BM, short): H5. Rekod Minimum bagi Setiap Kohort: 10 rekod minimum wajib bagi setiap kohort.

Requirement (EN): Access Control, Integrity & Privacy minimum controls: role-based access, identifiable/verified record modifications, audit trail on credential/ACR/credit/corrections, privacy/confidentiality, backup/continuity, controlled disposal, authorized external sharing.
Original wording (BM, short): H6. Kawalan Akses, Integriti dan Privasi Rekod: 7 kawalan minimum termasuk akses berasaskan peranan dan audit trail.

Requirement (EN): Change Control & Escalation rules for 7 trigger events: minor change (log & CQI), material change (HALT until evaluated/approved/QVC), substantive mode change (ODL referral), QV expired/suspended/revoked (HALT QV claims), credential/ACR/ABC error (authorized correction + audit trail), assessment integrity issue (preserve evidence & hold results), suspension/termination (identify active learners, set completion window/mapping/equivalence & notify).
Original wording (BM, short): H7. Kawalan Perubahan dan Eskalasi: 7 jenis perubahan/isu dengan tindakan awal dan rujukan/eskalasi khusus.

Requirement (EN): Governance Action Register (Item/Decision, Responsible Party, Target Date, Status Belum/Proses/Selesai, Evidence/Notes) + Governance Matrix Confirmation + Nota Penting keeping ACR, ABC deposit, credential, and internal achievement records separate.
Original wording (BM, short): H8. Daftar Tindakan Tadbir Urus + H9. Pengesahan Matriks Tadbir Urus + NOTA PENTING mengekalkan ACR, ABC, credential dan rekod dalaman secara berbeza.
